title: Global Partner Marketing & Operations Manager
description:
360Learning is looking for a Partner Marketing & Operations Manager to architect and scale the next generation of our global partner ecosystem. This is a highly strategic role at the intersection of marketing, alliances, operations, and growth, ideal for someone who wants to build and own the engine behind one of the fastest-growing partner programs in SaaS.

Your mission: turn our partner program into a world-class growth platform. You will design and orchestrate how we communicate, operate, and scale partnerships internally and externally. This means structuring clear, impactful enablement for our internal teams, while also building the marketing motions and engagement strategies that elevate our partners externally. You’ll harness AI agents, automation, and data to improve how we deliver partner intelligence, streamline collaboration, and amplify partner impact across the business.

Reporting directly to the Director of EMEA Alliances and collaborating cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Product, and Finance, you’ll be the driving force behind how we structure, market, and shine our partner program. You will also be responsible for scaling a digital-first approach for our Tier 3 partners globally, and have the responsibility for the sourcing and influence growth metrics.

Overview

The following responsibilities and expectations describe what the role does and what is needed to succeed in this position.

Responsibilities

Within 1 month, you will

  • Immerse yourself in our partner ecosystem, understanding our GTM strategy, current partner motions, and the opportunities ahead
  • Audit existing processes, documentation, and partner communications to identify quick wins and strategic priorities
  • Get hands-on with our tech stack (Salesforce, Atlassian tools, Looker, Dust) and explore how AI and automation can elevate partner engagement and enablement
  • Build relationships across Sales, CS, Product, Marketing, and Finance to align on how partnerships can create impact across the business
  • Get familiar with our Convexity culture

Within 3 months, you will

  • Own the narrative: Redesign our internal partner enablement hub (documentation, playbooks, GTM materials, and co-marketing resources) into a strategic asset for revenue teams
  • Build scalable foundations: Define partner program rules of engagement, partner tiering, and system integrator collaboration models that make partnering with 360Learning intuitive and high-impact
  • Operationalize value: Create and roll out a streamlined process for partnership referral fees, ensuring revenue impact is tracked, reported and optimized
  • Intelligence at scale: Deploy AI-powered tools and workflows to deliver real-time partner insights and automate internal communications, increasing productivity across the revenue org
  • Launch an improved partner newsletter and communication cadence, backed by clear engagement metrics and feedback loops

Within 6 months, you will

  • Scale operational excellence: Automate key workflows; from onboarding to content distribution to marketplace updates, making our partner program more efficient and more visible
  • Drive engagement: Launch targeted, data-driven marketing campaigns (high-touch and low-touch) that deepen partner collaboration and generate measurable pipeline influence
  • Be the source of truth: Build a comprehensive partner intelligence layer that helps internal teams act faster, sell smarter, and deliver greater value
  • Shape GTM impact: Partner with Sales and Marketing leadership to design joint initiatives that expand partner-sourced pipeline and accelerate customer adoption
  • Demonstrate a measurable lift in partner engagement (via newsletter open/click rates, shared content, or co-marketing activity) and direct impact on sourcing
  • Launch a scalable digital-first approach to improve the scale and impact of our Tier 3 partnerships

Within 12 months, you will

  • Be recognized as a key partner to the Alliances team for partner enablement and marketing strategy
  • Lead small scale partner campaigns end-to-end with minimal supervision
  • Contribute to the definition of the partner marketing roadmap and influence cross-functional strategy
  • Have taken steps toward owning or influencing the partner operations function in (processes, enablement, tooling)
  • Getting knowledge from Marketing and Ops current available info and processes

The Skill Set

  • 2-3 years of experience in partner marketing, marketing operations, or a related function (SaaS, consulting, or tech ecosystems preferred)
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, with a structured mindset around process, analysis, documentation and operations
  • Hands-on familiarity or strong willingness to learn Salesforce and the Atlassian suite (Confluence, Jira, Trello, Salesforce), and demonstrated understanding and use of AI Agent tools to create efficiency is a bonus
  • Comfortable working with external partners and cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Customer Success, and Marketing
  • Self-starter, equally comfortable in operations/process enablement and creative partner marketing execution
  • Fluency in English and French; German is a plus
  • Enthusiasm for our working environment explained in the knowledge base

What We Offer

  • Compensation: Package includes base salary, a variable component and equity
  • Benefits/Perks: Work From Home stipend, RTT, lunch vouchers, medical insurance, gym subscription, 1 month parental leave for the second parent.
  • Balance: Flexible hours, full remote work possible anywhere in France
  • Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion: 6 active ERGs including Mental Health, Environmental/Sustainability, Women, Parents, LGBTQIA2S+, and Ethnic Diversity. Each group has at least one executive team member serving as a member of the group, providing a quick path to impact
  • Corporate Social Responsibility: Review our CSR Charter: 360learning.com/blog/corporate-social-responsibility-charter
  • Culture: A framework that will help you make an impact - Convexity Culture: bit.ly/Convexity_360L and learn about teams, product and processes bit.ly/42H1ggC

The Interview Process

  • Phone Screen with our Talent Acquisition Manager
  • Discovery Meeting with our Director of EMEA Alliances
  • Case Study Meeting with our Director of EMEA Alliances and an Operations Manager
  • Clarification Meeting with our Senior Vice President Alliances
  • Culture Fit Meeting with our Chief Revenue Officer
  • Reference checks
  • Offer !

Get ready using our Knowledge Base: bit.ly/42H1ggC

Who We Are

360Learning enables companies to upskill from within by turning their experts into champions for employee, customer, and partner growth. With our LMS for collaborative learning, Learning & Development teams can accelerate upskilling with the help of internal experts instead of slow top-down training. 360Learning is the easiest way to onboard and upskill employees, train customer-facing teams, and enable customers and partners–all from one place.

360Learning powers the future of work at 1,700 organizations. Founded in 2013, 360Learning has raised $240 million with 400+ team members across North America and EMEA.

Learning Includes Everyone.

In concert with our culture, 360Learning believes learning includes everyone and that means embracing the strengths of diversity, connectedness, and inclusion. Through conscientious efforts, our global footprint celebrates cultures, perspectives, and experiences from all over the world to support our platform that is built for all regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, veteran status or any other aspect which makes an individual unique or protected by laws and regulations in the locations where we operate. Thus, 360Learning is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace, and we commit to continue this throughout our processes for recruitment, compensation, benefits, performance, promotion, and all other conditions and terms of employment.

Come build and scale the engine behind our Personal Lines growth. As Head of Digital Sales , you’ll be the leader for the digital sales channel, setting the vision, turning strategy into outcomes, and orchestrating cross-functional execution to move the numbers that matter.

  • Optimize the entire digital journey—from discovery to purchase and beyond—so every touchpoint is frictionless, high-converting, and loyalty-building.
  • Tell the story—communicate results and recommendations to senior leaders to secure alignment, resources, and momentum.
  • Stay on the front foot—track digital trends and the competitive landscape, and surface emerging technologies or partnerships (AI, data) that give our channel an edge.

Why this role

  • Big scope, real impact: own the strategy and performance of a critical growth channel.
  • Drive outcomes through influence; engage senior leaders across the business to move fast and deliver results.
  • Build for today and tomorrow: drive near-term performance while shaping the capabilities that differentiate us long term.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a business-related field (or equivalent experience) required; MBA and insurance designations (e.g., CPCU) strongly preferred; Personal Lines experience is a plus.
  • 10+ years of relevant experience, including 5+ years leading managers and cross-functional teams in large-scale operations or call center environments.
  • Proven track record of meeting and exceeding operational and sales targets in high-growth or high-volume settings.
  • Inspiring people leader with strong change management, coaching, and talent development skills; builds high-performance, inclusive cultures.
  • Strategic and analytical mindset with a bias for execution; uses data to prioritize, make trade-offs, and drive results.
  • Exceptional communication and influence—clear written and verbal communication, executive presence, presentation, active listening, and negotiation skills.

title: Principal Ai Engineer - Ai In Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE

We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.

In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.

Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.

Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers :

  • Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care
  • Automated coding and billing optimization
  • Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials
  • Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements

Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.

WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU

This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.

You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Build and Refine AI Products

  • Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers
  • Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy
  • Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions

2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

  • Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough
  • Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products
  • Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy

3. Own the Development Lifecycle

  • Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production
  • Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards

4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

  • Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process
  • Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space
  • In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base

REQUIRED EXPERTISE

1. Technical Skills

  • Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go
  • Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)
  • Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)
  • Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency
  • Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications
  • Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)

2. Mindset & Approach

  • Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment
  • Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly
  • A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team
  • Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing

3. Highly Valued Qualifications

  • Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar
  • Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change
  • Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures
  • Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)
  • Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management
  • Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We\'ll teach you what you need to know.

WHAT WE OFFER

1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

  • Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential
  • Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions
  • Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale

2. Professional Excellence

  • Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans
  • Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems
  • Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure
  • Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside

3. Work-Life Integration

  • Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones
  • Fast-paced environment where you\'ll learn constantly and be challenged daily
  • Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients
  • Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability

READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?

If you\'re a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.

Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

title: Head of Direct Response Center, Call Center Sales
description:
Overview

Come join our Direct Distribution team as Head of Direct Response Center, Call Center Sales , steering the engine of direct growth. As customers seek both convenience and trusted advice, our call center sales channel is where personalized experiences turn into loyalty and growth. In this role, you’ll be the leader for our Direct Response Center (DRC)—refining the strategy, driving execution, and delivering standout performance and continuous improvement.

You’ll lead a large, national sales operation and define what great looks like— elevating operational excellence, optimizing workforce and vendor partnerships, and building a culture that blends high performance with genuine care. You’ll also partner closely across Marketing, Product, Experience, Technology, and Analytics to shape an omnichannel journey that converts and delights. This role includes formal people leadership and reports to the General Manager, Direct Distribution.

What you’ll do:

  • Own the DRC sales strategy end to end—set bold goals tied to profitable growth, standout CX, and channel efficiency, and turn them into a clear, actionable roadmap.
  • Run the operation like a high-performance engine—drive execution and operational excellence across workforce management, staffing, scheduling, capacity planning, and vendor partnerships; flex fast and hit SLAs.
  • Build a championship team—recruit, coach, and elevate sales talent at every level; partner with Training/Enablement to accelerate ramp, sharpen skills, and grow future leaders.
  • Turn data into action, use real-time dashboards and KPI scorecards to spot signal, prioritize fixes, and deliver sustainable lifts and NPS, all while maintaining rock-solid compliance.
  • Lead transformation—roll out enablement tools and smarter processes to scale performance and unlock efficiency.
  • Orchestrate the journey—team up with Marketing, Product, Experience, Technology, and Analytics to enable intelligent routing, seamless digital-to-call and call-to-digital handoffs, and personalized offers that close.
  • Tell the story and drive decisions—deliver crisp, data-rich readouts to leadership; frame trade-offs, secure resourcing, and set a weekly/quarterly performance rhythm.
  • Shape the culture—foster an inclusive, high-accountability environment that celebrates wins, learns from misses, and always does the right thing for our customers and each other.

Why this role

  • Big scope, real impact: Own a national revenue engine—set the strategy, move the metrics that matter (conversion, NPS, efficiency), and see your decisions translate into tangible growth.
  • Build the future: Lead a transformation of tools, talent, and process—AI agent assist, smarter routing, enablement, and analytics—to create a modern, high-performing sales operation.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a business-related field (or equivalent experience) required; MBA and insurance designations (e.g., CPCU) strongly preferred; Personal Lines experience is a plus.
  • 10+ years of relevant experience, including 5+ years leading managers and cross-functional teams in large-scale operations or call center environments.
  • Proven track record of meeting and exceeding operational and sales targets in high-growth or high-volume settings.
  • Inspiring people leader with strong change management, coaching, and talent development skills; builds high-performance, inclusive cultures.
  • Strategic and analytical mindset with a bias for execution; uses data to prioritize, make trade-offs, and drive results.
  • Exceptional communication and influence—clear written and verbal communication, executive presence, presentation, active listening, and negotiation skills.

About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. title: Operating Partner
description:
Overview

An operating partner is a business leader who works with a company's leadership team to improve the business and create value for shareholders. They are often a key part of a firm's investment strategy and act as a liaison between the firm and its portfolio company. Their responsibilities can include:

  • Advising and coaching — Working with the CEO and management team to provide perspectives and recommendations.
  • Analyzing challenges — Identifying areas for improvement and developing plans to increase efficiency and growth.
  • Creating strategies — Developing plans to increase profits and cash flow, and implement operational best practices.
  • Monitoring performance — Tracking key performance indicators (KPIs) and financial performance.
  • Facilitating value creation — Ensuring the portfolio company has the resources to meet the firm's investment goals.
  • Supporting growth — Assisting with planning, forecasting, and due diligence to support company growth and expansion.
  • Building reporting — Creating simple, consistent reporting that makes it easy to identify when the company is off-track.
  • Leadership — To run a company you must be a leader. Full stop - no excuses. We are looking for Operating Partners who are natural born leaders.

What is the Cache Operating Partner Program?

The Cache Operating Partner Program is your opportunity to partner with Cache as the incoming CEO/COO/VP/GM/President of a newly acquired portfolio company.

Our Operating Partners are experienced leaders and operators currently working within a Software as a Service or Service-Based businesses in a sales, marketing, operations, or key management role. If you have a demonstrable track record of success and are looking to run an internet-based business as its operating CEO/COO/VP/GM/President we’d love to hear from you.

Applying as an Operating Partner puts you in our network for consideration when we acquire new businesses generating $500K-$5M in revenue. Operating Partners should expect excellent and unique compensation packages including equity and/or profit share participation.

Our Strategy

  • Plug & Play Systems — We use our proven playbooks to create and curate a database full of potential customers and invest in bringing value to them on an ongoing basis.
  • Remote Workforce — With a global footprint, we operate with a distributed team covering multiple time zones capable of serving our multinational customer base.
  • Winning Spirit — We bring a creative solutions mindset to problem-solving. No defeat, be optimistic. Pretty much everything is fixable, and most decisions are reversible.
  • Bunts & Singles — Narrow down the market to a specific customer that we can be the best at serving, and grow from there.

Our Thesis

There are intelligent entrepreneurs globally that are adept at identifying and building great software. Once these companies reach product-market-fit, it’s not uncommon for the company to grow beyond the founders’ core competencies.

By infusing capital and adding infrastructure, we can enable businesses to realize their full potential while continuing to scale the revenue profitably.

Our Focus

We seek to minimize risk and maximize returns, meaning we only invest in companies with a clear predictable path to success.

We will consider all types of business software and service companies, and specifically focus on the following:

  • Enterprise Software
  • SMB Software
  • Vertical Market Software
  • Tech Enabled Managed Services
  • IT Consulting
  • Ecommerce Software

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of operational leadership experience.
  • 5+ years of experience managing direct and/or indirect reports.
  • Extensive knowledge in operations, including resource planning, demand planning, business planning, corporate strategy, communications, leadership, benchmarking, and forecasting.
  • Required skills in market research, analytics, financial modeling, metrics analysis, and presentations.
  • Strong proficiency in Google Workspace and/or Microsoft 365.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize workloads and meet time-sensitive deadlines.
  • Must be results-oriented and adaptable to changing priorities.
  • Exceptional verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills, capable of interacting with all levels of associates with tact and diplomacy.
  • Proven ability to protect confidential information.
  • Ability to travel by automobile and aircraft, with the flexibility to be away from home for extended periods.
  • Experience in managing external relations, including identifying, diversifying, building, and maintaining relationships with community organizations and leaders to secure various forms of support and partnerships.
  • Ability to manage solicitations with board members and sponsors, provide outcome reports, and lead cultivation and stewardship activities for charitable endeavors.
  • Unique compensation packages including equity and/or profit share participation.
  • Competitive Health, Dental, and Vision benefits.
  • Work from anywhere in the world.
  • Loose vacation policy.
  • Flexible work hours.

Agro e Transformação Digital – características do agro brasileiro, desafios tecnológicos e iniciativas de inovação. Dados no Campo – fontes (sensores, drones, satélites, sistemas de gestão), tipos de dados, pré-processamento, armazenamento, pipelines de dados e qualidade. Aplicações da IA – pecuária de precisão (monitoramento, saúde, alimentação, produtividade) e integração de tecnologias (drones, IoT, decisões em tempo real). IA Generativa – usos no agro (relatórios, previsões, simulações, assistentes virtuais), modelos disponíveis, ferramentas e limitações. Mercado e Cases – startups, plataformas e resultados alcançados. Ética e Sustentabilidade – uso responsável de dados e automação, impactos ambientais, inclusão digital e desafios regulatórios, clareza na comunicação escrita e capacidade didática.

ENTREGAS PARA ESTA DEMANDA:

Analisar o conteúdo bruto e roteiros para garantir a pertinência temática e a atualidade das informações. Realizar correções de erros conceituais. Propor melhorias para o entendimento do conteúdo. Analisar a linearidade e coesão do texto, adicionando exemplos práticos para facilitar a compreensão e a contextualização. Análise e Otimização Visual (Imagens): Conferir as imagens presentes no material, verificando sua correção, adequação ao tema, público-alvo e contexto. Propor substituições de imagens, se necessário, indicando opções de bancos de imagens ou imagens autorais com boa resolução. Garantir que as imagens selecionadas ou propostas estejam em alta qualidade e resolvam visualmente as necessidades do texto. Garantia de Qualidade e Alinhamento: Validar as atividades e seus feedbacks para assegurar que simulam casos reais e incentivam a tomada de decisão. Validar materiais complementares, confirmando sua adequação ao público-alvo e sugerindo novos, se pertinente. Assegurar que o produto final esteja conforme a expectativa do cliente e do público, com linguagem e visual adequados, conforme especificações do curso. Responsabilizar-se por sinalizar e implementar os ajustes necessários para garantir a integridade e precisão do conteúdo. Conferir e recomendar bibliografia ou material complementar. Capacitação: Realizaremos um momento de alinhamento e capacitação com o validador, para garantir que ele compreenda integralmente as diretrizes pedagógicas, os objetivos do curso e os parâmetros esperados para a atualização. Validação interna da equipe (DI): Após a entrega do conteúdo validado, a DI realizará uma leitura e solicitará os ajustes necessários, assegurando a coerência pedagógica, a aderência aos objetivos de aprendizagem e a qualidade do material produzido. Ajustes e refinamento do conteúdo: Caso sejam identificadas inconsistências ou oportunidades de melhoria, o conteúdo retornará para ajustes por parte da conteudista, seguindo as orientações da DI. Finalização e conclusão da demanda: Com os ajustes finalizados e o conteúdo aprovado internamente, consideraremos a etapa de atualização concluída, encerrando a entrega conforme o escopo previsto no contrato.

Expertise nos temas mencionados acima. Desejável experiência em validação de material didático para EaD;

title: Head of Lifecycle Marketing
description:
About Remote

Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. You can find Remoters working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote. We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform.

If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!

The Position

This is an exciting time to join Remote and make a personal difference in the global employment space as a Head of Lifecycle Marketing. The Marketing team is the engine that powers Remote's expansion. Through product marketing, performance marketing, events, communications, campaigns, and content, we tell the world about Remote to bring in revenue and establish Remote as the international leader in global HR and remote work.

You’ll design and own the strategies that drive engagement, retention, and long-term customer value. This role is both strategic and hands-on — building a high-performing team while innovating across the customer journey to maximize impact.

What You Bring

  • Proven track record in lifecycle, CRM, or retention marketing, with success at scale in fast-paced environment.
  • Expertise in building and scaling customer lifecycle programs across multiple channels.
  • Strong analytical skills with a track record of leveraging data to inform strategy and execution.
  • Experience managing and scaling high-performing teams with a focus on ownership and accountability.
  • Deep understanding of customer segmentation, messaging, and personalization at scale.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a balance of creative vision and operational rigor.
  • Passion for innovation and elevating the digital customer experience.
  • Writes and speaks fluent English.
  • It\'s not required to have experience working remotely, but considered a plus.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end lifecycle marketing strategy, from onboarding to retention, upsell, and advocacy.
  • Lead and mentor a team of lifecycle and CRM marketers, fostering a culture of innovation and accountability.
  • Design and optimize multi-channel lifecycle programs (email, in-app, push, SMS, communities, etc.) that drive measurable impact.
  • Partner with Product, Data, and Growth to deliver personalized, customer-centric experiences.
  • Develop segmentation and targeting strategies to increase engagement, reduce churn, and grow LTV.
  • Establish KPIs and ensure continuous testing, measurement, and iteration of lifecycle initiatives.
  • Champion automation, personalization, and data-driven decision-making across the lifecycle function.

Application process

  1. Interview with recruiter
  2. Interview with future manager
  3. Interview with team members (no managers present)
  4. Bar Raiser Interview
  5. Prior employment verification check

The annual salary range for this full-time position is $179,300 — $302,600 USD.

Benefits

Our full benefits & perks are explained in our handbook at remote.com/r/benefits. As a global company, each country works differently, but some benefits/perks are for all Remoters:

  • work from anywhere
  • flexible paid time off
  • flexible working hours (we are async)
  • 16 weeks paid parental leave
  • mental health support services
  • stock options
  • learning budget
  • home office budget & IT equipment
  • budget for local in-person social events or co-working spaces

How you’ll plan your day (and life)

We work async at Remote which means you can plan your schedule around your life (and not around meetings). Read more at remote.com/async.

You will be empowered to take ownership and be proactive. When in doubt you will default to action instead of waiting. Your life-work balance is important and you will be encouraged to put yourself and your family first, and fit work around your needs.

If that sounds like something you want, apply now!

How to apply

  1. Please fill out the form below and upload your CV with a PDF format.
  2. We kindly ask you to submit your application and CV in English, as this is the standardised language we use here at Remote.
  3. If you don’t have an up to date CV but you are still interested in talking to us, please feel free to add a copy of your LinkedIn profile instead.

Not only do we encourage folks from all ethnic groups, genders, sexuality, age, abilities, disability status and any other under-represented group to apply, but we prioritize a sense of belonging. We have 4 ERGs (Women, Disability, Queer, Minorities in Tech) who meet regularly with the People team. During your interviews and beyond, we ask & encourage anybody who needs an accommodation to request one from their recruiter.

We will ask you to voluntarily tell us your pronouns at interview stage, and you will have the option to answer our anonymous demographic questionnaire when you apply below. As an equal employment opportunity employer it’s important to us that our workforce reflects people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences and this data will help us to stay accountable. We thank you for providing this data, if you chose to.

At Remote, we embrace AI as a valuable tool while prioritizing human creativity and authenticity. We look forward to meeting candidates who balance innovation with genuine expertise and experience. To learn more about Remote's AI guidelines check see

Please note we accept applications on an ongoing basis.

Job Description

The Director, IT Portfolio Management & Agile Services organizes and prioritizes projects and programs based on IT strategy, strategic roadmap, and available and prioritized budgets, and ensures that the appropriate financial and organizational support is allocated in support of those goals. The Director coaches, educates, and mentors leaders and teams to enable scaled, sustainable adoption of Agile practices (e.g., Scrum, Kanban, SAFe), promoting a culture of collaboration, transparency, predictability, and velocity.

The role establishes and maintains Lean Portfolio Management and Agile practices, standards, and guidelines to support transparent decision-making, investment funding, portfolio operations, and governance for the Growth & Digital portfolio. Decisions are typically related to the implementation of new/updated programs or large-scale projects for the function and supporting technical/operational procedures and processes, and the role implements strategic plans, drives goals and objectives, improves performance, and provides input into the function’s strategy.

12 month fixed term contract / full time (secondment opportunity). Applicants applying on a secondment basis must have the approval of their line manager before applying. Remember no one has every skill or experience needed for this role and you’ll have the opportunity to learn a lot from the team. We believe someone who has a few of these is well suited to exceed in this role:

  • Significant experience in PR, media-driven environments, or a similar field.

  • A commitment to equity, diversity, and inclusion in your communication and team-building efforts.
  • Demonstrable support for and belief in the Greenpeace network core aims and values.
  • Digital literacy skills; the ability to learn and utilise our digital platforms to successfully perform the role function (familiarity with G-Suite, Slack and Zoom is an advantage)

What you can expect

You’ll be encouraged to develop both personally and professionally, taking advantage of the wide range of learning and development opportunities available to our staff. Staff can also access our virtual wellness initiatives, such as mindfulness, yoga and meditation and also have the opportunity to join our global Equity, Diversity & Inclusion staff communities.

Please click HERE to visit the careers site, to learn more about working for Greenpeace.

About us

Greenpeace is a global campaigning network. It comprises 26 independent national/regional organisations, and a coordinating organisation, Greenpeace International. Greenpeace uses peaceful, creative confrontation to expose global environmental problems, and develop solutions for a green and peaceful future.

Our goal is to ensure the ability of the earth to nurture life in all its diversity. That means we want to:

  • protect biodiversity in all its forms
  • prevent pollution and abuse of the earth’s ocean, land, air and fresh water
  • end all nuclear threats
  • promote peace, global disarmament and non-violence

To Apply

If you share our vision, please click "apply for this job" below, to begin your application. To apply for this role, we require you to answer a selection of key criteria and upload your CV (in English) via our online application form. Addressing the key criteria is an important part of your application. We will be looking for evidence that demonstrates your skills and experience in these areas. Use examples where possible, to draw attention to experience, knowledge, achievements and skills gained in past employment or voluntary/leisure activities, provided they are relevant to the post. It’s advisable to prepare your responses to the key criteria before starting your online application, as you are unable to save and return to it at a later date.

At GPI , we understand there are potential benefits of using open AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT), however for the purpose of this application we prefer to see answers written by candidates themselves, so we can get a good impression on your thinking.

If you have any questions about this vacancy or the application process, please email us at Please note that all applications have to be filled out via the website and can't be submitted via this email.

We welcome everyone to apply for our positions. We understand that some candidates hesitate to apply unless they meet 100% of the criteria. However, we strongly encourage you to apply if you meet some of the key criteria for our roles. We’d love to know how your unique experience can bring value to our team. We believe in people power and having representation from many different communities to effect change.

description:
Area Manager - Outbound & Delivery, Fulfillment Center

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. Since our founding in 1994, we've grown from an online bookstore to a global technology leader in e-commerce, cloud computing, digital streaming, and artificial intelligence.

We distribute millions of products each year to our loyal customers across more than 100 countries. Our innovative spirit drives us to constantly push boundaries and redefine what's possible in logistics and delivery.

As we continue to expand our operations, we're seeking exceptional leaders who share our passion for innovation and customer obsession. At Amazon, you'll have the opportunity to work on projects, collaborate with world-class talent, and make a tangible impact on millions of customers' lives.

Role Overview: As an Area Manager - Outbound and Delivery, you will play a crucial role in our complex and fast-paced logistics network. This dynamic position combines responsibilities across our Fulfillment Center (FC) and Delivery Station (DS) operations, requiring a versatile leader who can seamlessly manage both outbound processes and delivery preparations.

You'll be at the forefront of our customer-facing operations, ensuring that millions of packages are processed efficiently and prepared for timely delivery. Your focus will span four key areas: safety, quality, customer experience, and productivity.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Team Leadership: Manage and develop a team of warehouse associates and delivery personnel, oversee performance, provide training, and address team member needs.
  • Operational Management: Review work forecasts and set productivity targets to meet overall building objectives, oversee the outbound process from order fulfillment to last-mile delivery preparation.
  • Safety & Compliance: Implement and support all safety programs and ensure OSHA compliance, maintain a safe work environment for all associates in both FC and DS areas.
  • Process Improvement: Identify and lead process improvement initiatives using Lean tools, analyze metrics to find root causes and drive operational enhancements.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Liaise with internal teams and external partners to ensure smooth outbound and delivery operations, communicate daily metrics and report exceptions to relevant departments.

A day in the life: Work flexible schedules, including nights, weekends, and holidays as required, operate in both Fulfillment Center and Delivery Station settings, thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced atmosphere.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent
  • Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
  • Can push and pull wheeled dollies loaded with products up to 100 pounds during shifts
  • Speak, write, and read fluently in English
  • Speak, write, and read fluently in Portuguese
  • Employee and performance management experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of Microsoft Excel at an advanced level, including: pivot tables, macros, index/match, vlookup, VBA, data links, etc.

Managers of Information Technology, Ledn is interested in hearing from you! Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first, environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. But, just as passionate about helping end users who are in need of help. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment.   • Detail solutions, craft help articles, and automate busywork.
  • Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion.
  • Balance help desk tickets with project work; work in sprints and document progress in Jira (adhere to agile methods).
  • Set and pursue objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Experience with open source tools (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.).
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows in Okta; working knowledge of APIs and system integrations.
  • Experience providing remote support across multiple countries/time zones; familiarity with hardware shipping/receiving and customs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to explain complex concepts clearly and empathetically.
  • Strong documentation skills and the ability to craft clear tickets, emails, and Slack messages.
  • Proven ability to self-manage, scope projects, and coordinate across multiple teams.
  • Strong organizational and task-management skills; comfortable dealing with ambiguity and making decisions with incomplete data.

Nice to Have

  • Some familiarity with AWS (no certifications required).
  • Experience with GAM and CLI work to increase efficiency.
  • Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace certifications.
  • Culture fit: leadership aligned with startup/tech environment values.

Our culture and expectations

  • Have a passion for progress; adaptable, resilient, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Builder’s mindset; eager to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
  • Collaborative partner across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially with confidential information.
  • Experience working in a remote environment.

What We Provide

  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package starting on day one.
  • Competitive PTO package and ownership in the company; equity through shared ownership.
  • Opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (restrictions apply).
  • A career with purpose; we remove barriers so you love what you do.
  • We are an equal opportunity employer; inclusive and diverse, with success from diversity.

Application and Environment

  • You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.
  • Ledn is a globally distributed, remote-first team spanning North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe.
  • Due to high volume of applications, only qualified applicants will be contacted.
  • As part of the selection process, shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role.
  • No agencies or recruiters. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and are not responsible for fees related to unsolicited resumes.

  • Develop a collaborative workflow with the sales team to assess and refine lead quality.

  • Expand a full-funnel paid media strategy aligned with customer purchasing behaviors.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with different teams, including Sales, Revenue Operations, Product, and Data, to ensure a cohesive GTM strategy and a seamless customer journey that maximizes revenue outcomes.

Remote Compensation Philosophy

Remote\'s Total Rewards philosophy is to ensure fair, unbiased compensation and fair equity pay along with competitive benefits in all locations in which we operate. We do not agree to or encourage cheap-labor practices and therefore we ensure to pay above in-location rates. We hope to inspire other companies to support global talent-hiring and bring local wealth to developing countries.

At first glance our salary bands seem quite wide - here is some context. At Remote we have international operations and a globally distributed workforce. We use geo ranges to consider geographic pay differentials as part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive in various markets while we hiring globally.

The base salary range for this full-time position is $210,250- $315,350. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level and location, and our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay for the successful candidate in this role is dependent upon many factors such as location, transferable or job-related skills, work experience, relevant training, business needs, and market demands. The base salary range may be subject to change.

At Remote, we foster internal mobility as a key element of our culture of employee growth and development, supported by a compensation philosophy that guarantees pay equity and fairness. Therefore, all compensation changes associated with an internal move will be reviewed by the Total Rewards & People Enablement team on a case by case basis.

title: Project Manager
description:
Overview

Caylent is a cloud native services company that helps organizations bring the best out of their people and technology using Amazon Web Services (AWS). We provide a full-range of AWS services including workload migrations and modernization, cloud native application development, DevOps, data engineering, security and compliance, and everything in between.

At Caylent, our people always come first. We are a global company and operate fully remote with employees in Canada, the United States, and Latin America. We celebrate the culture of each of our team members and foster a community of technological curiosity. Come talk to us to learn more about what it means to be a Caylien!

The Mission

We are seeking an exceptional Project Manager to join our growing Cloud Project Management team. The right candidate is someone who thrives in a customer-facing environment, is highly organized, and passionate about helping teams deliver meaningful cloud solutions.

Your mission will be to work collaboratively with engineering teams and customer stakeholders to ensure project goals and engagement expectations are met. You will help guide Agile delivery, act as Scrum Master where appropriate, and contribute to delivering high-quality solutions using a consultative approach. You may also support internal initiatives such as mentoring or contributing to deliver best practices as part of team growth and maturity.

Your Assignment

  • Manage cloud delivery projects from planning to execution in collaboration with engineers, architects, and customer stakeholders.
  • Facilitate Agile ceremonies including daily standups, sprint planning, demos, and retrospectives.
  • Act as Scrum Master where needed, tracking progress, resolving blockers, and ensuring alignment to project goals.
  • Collaborate with customer Product Owners and Caylent team members to shape and maintain technical user stories.
  • Monitor forecasting, time tracking, and budget alignment to meet delivery expectations.
  • Report regularly on project scope, progress, risks, and deliverables in alignment with the Statement of Work.
  • Develop strong relationships through clear communication and by championing the project experience.
  • Identify risks or roadblocks early and guide teams through resolution.
  • Surface potential opportunities for account growth during project delivery.
  • Support continuous improvement by contributing to team knowledge sharing and delivery practices.

Your Qualifications

Core Consulting Qualifications

Customer Experience
• Builds trust with senior stakeholders through transparency, clear communication, and reliable follow-through.
• Proactively identifies and mitigates risks that could impact project success or customer satisfaction.

Collaboration
• Facilitates priority alignment across internal and external teams, ensuring shared goals and expectations.
• Resolves conflicts and escalations with professionalism, balancing delivery realities with customer needs.

Communication
• Navigates challenging conversations, such as scope changes or misaligned expectations, with confidence and clarity.
• Remains composed in unexpected situations, clarifies misunderstandings, and proposes actionable next steps.

Technical Qualifications
• 5+ years of experience in client-facing PM/Scrum role in a technical or consulting environment.
• Managed projects with at least 3+ team members and $250,000+ in budget.
• Strong background in Agile/Scrum delivery and tools (Jira).
• Experience leading engagements in application development, cloud modernization, or data engineering.
• Strong communication and time management skills, with ability to work across technical and business teams.

Preferred Qualifications

• PMP, CSM, or other Agile/PM certifications.
• Cloud certification (AWS Practitioner or equivalent)

  • Paid for exams and certifications
  • Peer bonus awards
  • State of the art laptop and tools
  • Equipment & Office Stipend
  • Annual stipend for Learning and Development
  • Work with an amazing worldwide team and in an incredible corporate culture

Overview

Join to apply for the Information Technology Manager role at LEDN

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. We are a remote-first company with a global team and a culture driven by integrity, accountability, and progress.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, and is committed to helping end users who need assistance.

Responsibilities

  • Participate in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks.
  • Support end users via channels such as Slack and Jira; own the first line of support.
  • Procure and deliver technology equipment; manage onboarding and offboarding of employees.
  • Design, test, build, and document programs, tools and policies; contribute improvements to existing knowledge bases.
  • Support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.).
  • Manage Mac endpoints and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM, Jamf, etc.).
  • Own and contribute to improvements on identity providers and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.).
  • Document solutions, craft help articles, and automate routine tasks.
  • Manage incidents and issues to resolution; prioritize help desk tickets and work on projects with agile methods.
  • Set and pursue objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

Qualifications & Skills

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (e.g., Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, Python, etc.; familiarity with open source tools (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.).
  • Experience integrating SSO into Okta and building workflows in Okta; strong API integration skills.
  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; capable of hardware shipping/receiving and customs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication across media; clear, concise, and culturally sensitive communication.
  • Proficiency in documentation, tickets, emails, and Slack communications.
  • Strong problem-solving ability with knowledge of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs) and OSI model troubleshooting.
  • Ability to self-manage, scope projects, and coordinate across multiple teams.

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line interfaces.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture & Fit

We’re looking for a leader who thrives in a startup or tech environment and embodies our values: act with integrity, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. A builder’s mindset, adaptability, resilience, and the ability to operate in ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment are highly valued. We value collaboration, empathy, and impact across functions and cultures.

What We Provide

  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package starting on day one; competitive PTO; ownership in the company through equity.
  • Remote work opportunity worldwide for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A purpose-driven role with opportunities for growth in a global digital asset company.

About Our Environment & Application Process

Ledn is globally distributed with a remote-first culture. Due to high volume, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes.

EEO & Contact

We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity and diversity. You may reach out for accommodation requests during all stages of the recruitment process at the designated email. Requests will be handled confidentially.

Sobre Nossa Cultura

Na nossa empresa, acreditamos firmemente que Gente é o nosso principal ingrediente . A paixão pelo que fazemos impulsiona o nosso time, dedicado à qualidade inegociável das nossas entregas, proporcionando o melhor aos nossos consumidores. Nosso time é mão na massa, com uma atitude proativa para enfrentar desafios e alcançar novos patamares.

Orgulhamo-nos da solidez e integridade que nos tornam reconhecidos no mercado, com mais de 1.000 lojasespalhadas pelo Brasil para atender aos nossos consumidores.

A cultura brasileira é vivenciada, reconhecida e manifestada em forma de arte, resultando em deliciosos chocolates que refletem a riqueza de nossa identidade.

Kop Koffee: Criada em 2019, a Kop Koffee é o lugar perfeito para compartilhar momentos de prazer, unindo o sabor do café à inconfundível qualidade dos chocolates Kopenhagen. Aqui, o sabor de inovação não é apenas um ingrediente, mas a energia que nos impulsiona a seguir inovando continuamente e proporcionando uma experiência única para os apaixonados por café e chocolate.

Descubra o incrível universo do chocolate, onde cada conexão transforma momentos comuns em experiências extraordinárias. Sinta-se convidado a fazer parte desse cenário envolvente e deixe sua marca, contribuindo para tornar cada momento inesquecível nesse universo apaixonante do chocolate.

title: Senior Identity and Access Management (IAM) Analyst / Engineer
description:
Overview

Why should you join dLocal? dLocal enables the biggest companies in the world to collect payments in 40 countries in emerging markets. Global brands rely on us to increase conversion rates and simplify payment expansion effortlessly. As both a payments processor and a merchant of record where we operate, we make it possible for our merchants to make inroads into the world’s fastest-growing, emerging markets.

By joining us you will be a part of an amazing global team that makes it all happen, in a flexible, remote-first dynamic culture with travel, health and learning benefits, among others. Being a part of dLocal means working with 1000+ teammates from 30+ different nationalities and developing an international career that impacts millions of people’s daily lives. We are builders, we never run from a challenge, we are customer-centric, and if this sounds like you, we know you will thrive in our team.

Do you want to be at the intersection of Identity & Access Management and software engineering? We are looking for someone who not only masters IAM solutions in complex environments, but also thinks like a developer by building automations, integrations and scalable solutions for the future of our IAM ecosystem. Important to know: we are in a transition phase. Many IAM processes are still manual today. That means even our engineers will roll up their sleeves and handle operational tasks, while also designing and implementing the automations that will replace them in the near future.

Responsibilities

  • Act in the implementation and administration of Identity and Access Management solutions
  • Integrate different internal systems into the IAM solutions
  • Configure conditional access rules
  • Implement function segregation rules
  • Configure access certification flows and other access management controls
  • Support current manual IAM operations while helping design their automation journey
  • Develop Python scripts, tools, and integrations to progressively automate IAM processes (provisioning, deprovisioning, certification, reporting, etc.)
  • Collaborate with the team to evolve from manual processes into scalable and automated IAM solutions
  • Design and implement connectors and automations for hundreds of SaaS applications in addition to multi-cloud environments

Qualifications

  • Strong background in Access Management in critical environments
  • Experience with user access management in a multi-cloud environment
  • Hands-on experience with IAM in large SaaS ecosystems (hundreds of tools, diverse integrations, custom connectors)
  • Advanced knowledge in Identity Management flows and processes
  • Familiarity with the administration and implementation of any of the IAM solutions (EntraID, Sailpoint, Okta, Forgerock, RSA or others)
  • Know-how of EntraID and how integrations with it work
  • Understanding of connectors configuration, protocols (SAML 2.0, LDAP, etc.), approval flows, reports and other activities that are part of the IAM process - Knowledge in SOD and RBAC methodology
  • Strong Python development skills, with experience building automation, scripts, and APIs - Understanding of DevOps practices (Git, CI/CD, containers) and cloud-native environments
  • Knowledge of security best practices in Python development, including secrets management and secure coding
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible or similar) is a plus
  • Great interpersonal skills, both oral and written communication, negotiation with internal suppliers and customers, critical and analytical sense and time management
  • Desire to achieve team success and ability to mentor colleagues

Benefits

  • Remote work: work from anywhere or one of our offices around the globe!
  • Flexibility: we have flexible schedules and we are driven by performance.
  • Fintech industry: work in a dynamic and ever-evolving environment, with plenty to build and boost your creativity.
  • Referral bonus program: our internal talents are the best recruiters - refer someone ideal for a role and get rewarded.
  • Learning & development: get access to a Premium Coursera subscription.
  • Language classes: we provide free English, Spanish, or Portuguese classes.
  • Social budget: you\'ll get a monthly budget to chill out with your team (in person or remotely) and deepen your connections!
  • dLocal Houses: want to rent a house to spend one week anywhere in the world coworking with your team? We’ve got your back!
  • *For people based in Montevideo (Uruguay) applying to non-IT roles, 55% monthly attendance to the office is required

What happens after you apply? Our Talent Acquisition team is invested in creating the best candidate experience possible, so don’t worry, you will definitely hear from us. We will review your CV and keep you posted by email at every step of the process!

Also, you can check out our webpage, Linkedin, Instagram, and Youtube for more about dLocal!

Precisamos de um(a) fornecedor(a) tutor(a) com experiência em educação e nos atendimentos de alunos, que tenha facilidade no uso de tecnologia, clareza na comunicação escrita e verbal e capacidade didática.

ENTREGAS PARA ESTA DEMANDA:

  • Acompanhar diariamente e individualmente alunos no Ambiente Virtual de Aprendizagem, apoiando no entendimento de conceitos e na resolução de problemas;

  • Planejar e executar estratégias no Ambiente Virtual de Aprendizagem que estimulem o pensamento crítico e a participação ativa dos alunos;

  • Mediar processo de aprendizagem e esclarecer dúvidas de forma precisa e com informações relevantes;

  • Mediar fóruns de dúvidas e de discussão;

  • Planejar, cadastrar e conduzir aulas online síncronas por meio de ferramenta de webconferência, agendada no período noturno conforme o calendário de cada Unidade Curricular;

  • Corrigir atividades avaliativas para avaliar o entendimento e o progresso dos alunos ao longo da Unidade Curricular;

  • Incentivar a motivação intrínseca dos alunos, mostrando a relevância e aplicabilidade do conteúdo estudado;

  • Demonstrar empatia e compreensão em relação às necessidades dos alunos, criando um ambiente de aprendizagem acolhedor e inclusivo em todas as mediações realizadas;

  • Desenvolver habilidades de escuta ativa para entender as preocupações e dificuldades dos alunos e oferecer suporte apropriado.

PARA PRESTAR ESTE SERVIÇO VOCÊ PRECISA:

  • Graduação em Zootecnia (preferencialmente), Engenharia Agronômica, Medicina Veterinária, área de Ciências Agrárias (Engenharia Agrícola, Agronomia); ou Curso Superior de Tecnologia em Agronegócio com experiência comprovada de pelo menos 2 anos na área;

  • Pós-graduação (Doutorado, mestrado ou especialização lato sensu) em uma das seguintes áreas de atuação: Extensão rural, Assessoria e Consultoria, Assistência Técnica, Políticas Públicas do Meio Rural ou áreas afins;

At BairesDev®, we've been leading the way in technology projects for over 15 years. We deliver cutting-edge solutions to giants like Google and the most innovative startups in Silicon Valley.

Join a global team where your unique talents can truly thrive and make a significant impact!

What you\'ll be doing

  • Performs data analysis required to troubleshoot data-related issues and assist in the resolution of data issues.
  • Work within AWS/Linux cloud systems environment in support of data integration solution
  • Works closely with a team of frontend and backend engineers, product managers, and analysts.

Company Benefits

  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.
  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Technology / Office stipend

  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences

  • Total Pass: academias e aplicativos educacionais com descontos;
  • Wellhub: academias e aplicativos educacionais com descontos;
  • Acesso ao Sesc São Paulo.

Sobre a empresa

Somos a BetterNow, uma consultoria em qualidade de software que valoriza relações próximas, processos simples e um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo. Nosso propósito é criar soluções que realmente façam a diferença, com foco na excelência, na transparência e na entrega de valor para os nossos clientes. Aqui, você vai encontrar uma cultura aberta, que valoriza a troca de ideias, o aprendizado contínuo e a autonomia.   • Curious & Forward-Looking: Constantly explores new approaches to personalization and actively prototypes cutting-edge methodologies.

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!

description:
Overview / Company Overview

Our client is a legal technology company that utilizes AI to help law firms work more efficiently. They’re partnering with a high-volume immigration firm to streamline operations and reduce manual work, making legal processes faster and more efficient. With a focus on practical, user-friendly solutions, they’re building tools that support real-world legal work and improve day-to-day workflows. It’s a solid opportunity to be part of a growing product with real impact in the legal space.

Your Role

As a Staff Frontend Engineer , you will play a key role in designing and implementing core user-facing features, guiding frontend architecture, and shaping how users interact with the product. You will collaborate closely with design, product, and backend teams to ensure high-quality, accessible, and responsive interfaces. You’ll also support real-time experiences in the browser and contribute to broader technical direction across the frontend. This role is ideal for an experienced frontend engineer who enjoys solving complex UI problems, mentoring others, and driving consistent, thoughtful user experiences in a fast-moving environment.

Interview Preparation Guide

Key Responsibilities

  • Frontend Development: Lead the development of intuitive, responsive user interfaces using modern JavaScript frameworks and Tailwind CSS. Ensure accessibility, consistency, and performance across devices.
  • Architecture & Design Systems: Contribute to the evolution of our frontend architecture and design system. Define patterns and abstractions that promote code quality, maintainability, and development speed.
  • Real-Time Interfaces: Support real-time browser-based features by integrating with WebSocket-powered systems. Help ensure smooth, low-latency UI updates for features like in-browser voice interactions or live status indicators.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with backend engineers, designers, and product managers to scope and deliver cohesive, well-integrated features that align with user needs and product goals.
  • Performance Optimization: Continuously monitor and improve frontend performance and reliability, especially in complex user flows or real-time environments.
  • Code Quality & Best Practices: Drive high standards in frontend development through regular code reviews, testing, and mentorship. Help other engineers navigate frontend complexity and unblock progress.

Technical Proficiency

Must have experience with several of the following:

  • Front-End Technologies: Advanced proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript, with strong experience in frameworks such as React, Vue.js, or Angular. Familiarity with CSS tooling like Tailwind is a plus.
  • Real-Time Interfaces: Experience building browser-based features that use WebSockets or similar technologies for real-time updates and interactivity.
  • UI/UX Implementation: Strong understanding of layout, accessibility, and design integration. Comfortable translating high-fidelity designs into reliable, user-friendly interfaces.
  • API Integration: Fluent in working with RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs to connect frontend features to backend systems, including thoughtful handling of loading, errors, and edge cases.
  • Testing & Quality Assurance: Experience with automated frontend testing frameworks such as Jest, Cypress, or Testing Library. Strong focus on preventing regressions and maintaining confidence in releases.
  • Cloud Platforms & CI/CD: Familiarity with cloud-hosted frontend environments (e.g., on AWS or GCP) and with CI/CD tooling such as GitHub Actions or GitLab CI to support a stable deployment pipeline.

Qualifications

  • Experience : 8+ years in frontend development, with a proven track record of owning major UI projects and delivering high-quality, production-grade interfaces at scale.
  • Technical Expertise : Strong background in modern frontend architecture and development practices, including state management, performance tuning, and design system usage or implementation.
  • Problem Solving : Skilled at navigating complex user interaction problems and delivering clear, reliable solutions that balance technical constraints and user needs.
  • Collaboration : Able to work effectively within a cross-functional team and communicate clearly with designers, engineers, and product stakeholders.
  • Mentorship : Experience mentoring engineers and contributing to a collaborative, growth-oriented engineering culture.

  • Competitive Pay
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off
  • Professional Growth
  • Collaborative Team
  • Home Office Stipend
  • Latest Tech Gear
  • Team Retreats and Virtual Events

  1. Introductory Chat: A 30-minute call to discuss the role and your background.
  2. Technical Assessment: A hands-on coding challenge focused on Python.

You Might Be a Fit If You…

  • Have 5+ years as a full stack developer with a strong emphasis on React/TypeScript and Node.js
  • Built and maintained production services on AWS, from Lambda functions to managed databases
  • Write clean, tested, maintainable code and enjoy automating deployment pipelines

  • Value collaborative engineering practices: agile ceremonies, code reviews, and shared ownership
  • Hold an AWS Certification (e.g., Solutions Architect, Developer) — or are eager to earn one

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with Java/Spring Boot (legacy platform support or migration)

Position Details

  • Location: Remote (US-Based, EST core hours preferred; flexible)
