Overview

Sales Lead – GoodParty.org is looking for a Sales Lead to help reinvent civic leadership in America. You will lead our high performing Top-of-Funnel outbound calling team. Your focus will shift throughout the year between initial candidate outreach and nurturing relationships to drive conversions to our product and service offerings. The ideal candidate excels in prospecting new leads, guiding a team, and deepening relationships with engaged users to promote product adoption.

About GoodParty.org :

GoodParty.org is on a mission to make people matter more than money in our democracy by empowering Independent candidates to run, win, and serve. Our AI-powered platform provides free tools to Independent candidates to run their campaigns, connect with voters, and serve their communities effectively.

A majority of eligible voters, including more than half of Millennials and Gen Z, say that neither Republicans nor Democrats represent them. GoodParty.org is the solution. In 2024 we empowered 3,444 Independent candidate wins across 48 states from all across the ideological spectrum. The elected officials we empower prioritize people over parties and community over corporate interests. In 2024, 40.3 million votes (26% of all voters) cast a ballot for our candidate users. We’re not a political party; we’re a platform and a movement to democratize democracy.

Founded by serial entrepreneur Farhad Mohit, GoodParty.org is building solutions so we can have a truly representative democracy where society’s biggest problems are solved.

What you’ll do

  • Lead and coach a team of contract outreach reps by coordinating daily/weekly priority call lists, setting pipeline goals, and ensuring high-quality, high-impact conversations.
  • Create and refine recommended talk tracks, email templates, call scripts, and objection handling guides to improve outreach conversion and candidate quality.
  • Monitor outreach performance and call quality, providing insights or resources to help reps improve results.
  • Own and execute candidate outreach at the top of the funnel, introducing prospective independent and nonpartisan candidates to GoodParty.org and sparking their interest in running for office using our tools.
  • Drive initial engagement by clearly communicating our mission, platform benefits, and the unique value of running independently with GoodParty.org’s support.
  • Manage a high-volume outreach pipeline in HubSpot, maintaining accurate records, tracking engagement, and ensuring consistent, personalized follow-ups.
  • When bandwidth allows, make outreach calls to contribute to top-of-funnel goals.
  • Pilot and implement new messaging strategies, tools, and AI enhancements – testing what works and scaling what doesn’t across the team.
  • Share top-of-funnel insights with internal teams to help inform platform positioning, marketing strategy, candidate personas, and product messaging.
  • Bring a startup mindset to everything you do by experimenting, learning fast, and iterating to drive candidate pipeline growth and readiness.
  • Report to the Senior Sales Manager who oversees all sales teams.

Who we’re looking for

  • You're up for the audacious challenge of driving money out of politics and democratizing democracy.
  • You have 4-5 years of experience in outreach, sales, or business development, 2+ years in tech sales with 1+ years experience as a team lead.
  • You're skilled at building trust with team members, moving conversations toward action.
  • You explain complex tools simply and clearly, and communicate expectations with confidence and empathy.
  • You're organized, self-directed, and comfortable managing pipelines in HubSpot while hitting engagement goals.
  • You're tech-savvy and already using AI tools that boost performance.
  • You thrive in a fast-paced, remote, startup environment where you can make things happen without a lot of red tape.
  • You've trained or coached team members on talk tracks, objection handling, or outreach strategies.

Bonus if

  • You've used your outreach or sales skills in a social impact, nonprofit, or political environment, either professionally or as a volunteer.
  • You've built or optimized CRM workflows, automation sequences, or reporting dashboards—especially in high-volume outreach teams.
  • You've worked in civic tech, political campaigns, or democracy-focused initiatives and understand the unique challenges of this space.
  • You've deployed AI tools for outreach (e.g. call summarizers, email generators, or LLMs) to improve efficiency and personalization.

Why you should work at GoodParty.org

  • Join us in solving the biggest problem of our time – fixing our democracy – so all other problems can be solved.
  • We’re a Public Benefit Corporation that prioritizes social impact over profit.
  • Innovative Bitcoin-denominated deferred bonus plan, allowing you to have the amazing upside of being in a startup while working on a truly meaningful mission.
  • Work where and how you like, on a fully remote team spread across the country.
  • Join a passionate team with diverse political views focused on one mission.
  • 100% coverage of health, dental, and vision benefits for you and your dependents.
  • We encourage you to take time off to recharge and have an unlimited PTO policy.
  • 401(k) program available (no employer match).
  • Individual learning & development budget to fund your growth.
  • Workspace setup stipend to support remote work; $50/month for home internet if you work from home. Co-working can be discussed as an option.
  • Fully funded for our mission. No stress over funding rounds; focus on impact.

The salary range is $80,000-$90,000 + commission for this remote, full-time position with excellent benefits. This range reflects compensation at the time of posting. We may pay more or less than the posted range. Salary within range depends on factors including experience, skills, seniority, education, certifications, and organizational needs. We reserve the right to modify this pay range at any time.

We are not considering candidates currently based outside of the US, so please only apply if you are physically located in the US. Unfortunately, we are not able to provide sponsorship for any of our roles at this time.

Ready to apply or learn more?

We hope you’ll apply! You can also keep up with the latest by signing up at GoodParty.org. If you know anyone else who may be interested, please share this job posting – thanks!

5-years experience in email marketing (Klaviyo experience is a plus!)

Fluent in English with Excellent Communication Skills

Since you will have at least monthly calls with American clients, you should be fluent in English. Strong interpersonal and communication skills are also crucial.

Time Management

You’ll be expected to manage your work schedule and the schedules of team members operating across many different time zones. Working early in EST hours may be required.

You’ll need terrific time management skills to hit deadlines and deliver excellent results.

Communication Skills

Strategists are great note-takers and comfortable conversationalists that intuitively understand how to best communicate with clients. Whether you’re writing a quick email or hopping on an hour-long call, you should be able to get your point across quickly and clearly.

Marketing or Sales Experience

Our Strategists are a client facing role. Flowium, and we want our clients to know they are in good hands. Experience with working in a sales or marketing environment is important when not only dealing with an array of people but the implementation of new ideas as well.

  • Passion for marketing and developing data-driven strategies

  • A team player who enjoys working with a team of diverse backgrounds
  • A leader with ability to share their knowledge in strategy creation
  • A creative individual who implements new marketing concepts regularly
  • A stickler for deadlines who wants the occasional curveball

You will join a global team that is 100% location independent and exclusively uses remote collaboration. As a self-motivated and responsible individual, you will be free to work from any location.

We want our team members to maintain a flexible and healthy lifestyle with an overall work-life balance. We support team members in managing their own time, including Paid Time Off. We’re proud to offer an Open Paid Time Off Policy where time off is not micromanaged or limited. We trust and respect our team members in their commitment to the overall success of Flowium.

We use the best tools available to make your process as smooth and as comfortable as possible. These include Asana, Slack, Loom, Miro, and Klaviyo. If you’re not familiar with a tool we rely on, don’t worry -- we’ll make you an expert.

Overview

A Minerva Foods é líder em exportação de carne bovina na América do Sul e atua também no segmento de industrializados, comercializando seus produtos para mais de 100 países. Além do Brasil, a Minerva Foods está presente no Paraguai, na Argentina, no Uruguai, na Colômbia, e possui plantas especializadas em ovinos na Austrália.

Com nossas 46 unidades industriais, oferecemos produtos saudáveis e nutritivos, que são comercializados para clientes do mundo todo por meio de nossos 23 centros de distribuição e 17 escritórios internacionais.

Cultura Organizacional

Na Minerva Foods, a cultura é construída com base em valores como orientação para resultados, comprometimento, inovação, sustentabilidade e reconhecimento . A empresa promove um ambiente inclusivo, seguro e saudável, com programas como o Estar Bem, que oferece apoio psicológico, telemedicina, nutrição e atividades físicas para colaboradores e suas famílias.

Como Especialista de Infraestrutura na Minerva Foods, você será responsável pela operação e manutenção de ambientes críticos de tecnologia, garantindo a estabilidade, disponibilidade e performance dos serviços corporativos. Atuará diretamente na sustentação de servidores, redes, serviços em nuvem e suporte de nível avançado, colaborando com equipes internas e fornecedores para assegurar a continuidade dos negócios. Além disso, será parte ativa na identificação de oportunidades de melhoria contínua, contribuindo para a evolução dos processos, aumento da eficiência operacional e redução de riscos técnicos.

Main responsibilities

O Especialista de Infraestrutura será um pilar técnico na equipe, responsável por garantir que nossos sistemas e redes operem com máxima eficiência, segurança e escalabilidade.

Principais atividades:

Additionally, Private Equity firms, their investors, legal partners, and portfolio companies interact with our platform through different user personas and permissions, making robust access control and tailored experiences essential.

We’re also expanding to support a wide range of ownership management workflows. The scope and impact of each individual on the team are immense. We are biased toward action and believe in the mantra: build → measure → learn. As part of our team, you\'ll work closely with product managers and designers to understand the motivation (why) behind a customer need, define the scope of work (what), and collaborate with your engineering peers to build solutions (how) that deliver meaningful customer value.

At Félix, we're building the financial ecosystem for Latin immigrants in the U.S., starting with a revolution in remittances. Our core product is an AI-powered chatbot built on WhatsApp, allowing our users to send money home as easily as sending a text message. We leverage cutting-edge technology like AI, blockchain, and stablecoins to make cross-border payments faster, more affordable, and more accessible than ever before.

We are a hyper-growth Series B company, backed by over $100 million in funding from top-tier global investors, including QED, Castle Island, Switch Ventures, HTwenty, Monashees, and General Catalyst Customer Value Fund. This isn't just about the numbers; it's a testament to the trust our investors have in our vision and our team. Additionally, the Félix founders were selected as “Endeavour Entrepreneurs” and were recipients of the CrossTech Fintech Startups Award. We are a group of extremely talented and dedicated high-performers, united by our shared obsession with a single goal: empowering our customers. We are all owners of Félix, driven by a bias for action and a true experimentation spirit to get things done with urgency and focus.

Joining Félix means you will be part of a team building a legacy, a company that will outlive us all. This is a rare opportunity to apply your skills to a deeply meaningful mission—serving a community that has been underserved for too long. We are a team that is fiercely loyal to each other, where radical transparency and constructive feedback are how we grow and push for excellence. We are bold, we care less about what others are doing, and more about creating sustainable value and a product that truly makes our users' lives better. We are building the future, today.

This role is open to all candidates in Latin America.

About the Role

As a key member of our engineering team, you will have a unique opportunity to shape the core technology behind our chat-driven platform. You will work on Felix Pago’s Chat Platform — a sophisticated system that not only processes high volumes of transactions but also delivers conversational experiences through integrated chatbots and natural language interfaces. Your role will be crucial in designing and enhancing interactive chat services that enable seamless, intuitive user interactions on platforms like WhatsApp. If you have experience building chatbots or crafting conversational experiences, this is your chance to make a significant impact.

Technology Stack:

  • We are technology agnostic and value candidates with diverse backgrounds. While familiarity with the following is helpful, your willingness to learn and adapt is paramount:
  • Front-end: React, HTTP, HTML/DOM, JavaScript, CSS, AJAX
  • Back-end: Python, Flask/FastAPI, REST APIs, Redis, SQL, gRPC
  • Cloud: Google Cloud services (Firestore, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, Google Artifact Registry, Cloud Run, BigQuery, Cloud Composer, etc.)
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes, Terraform, NewRelic, PagerDuty

Responsibilities:

  • Design & Architecture: Architect and implement high-performance, scalable backend microservices, including core components of our Chat Platform.
  • Conversational Interfaces: Build, deploy, and iterate on chatbot services and conversational interfaces that empower users to interact naturally with our remittance services.
  • Infrastructure: Design and manage infrastructure capable of handling millions of daily requests with real-time messaging capabilities.
  • Web Development: Utilize web development technologies to build user-facing applications that integrate seamlessly with our chat-based solutions.
  • Cloud Integration: Develop backend services using established industry standards and Google Cloud services.
  • Collaboration & Mentorship: Foster the growth of junior developers through mentorship and best practice implementation, while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams including product, UX/UI, and business units.
  • Continuous Improvement: Leverage customer feedback and analytics to iterate and improve our conversational experience, ensuring that our chatbots remain effective and user-friendly.
  • Proficiency in English at an Upper-Intermediate level or higher is required.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience as a Software Engineer in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proven ability to build, ship, and iterate on software applications with an emphasis on real-world impact.
  • Strong foundation in algorithms and data structures.
  • Experience with web services, including SOAP and REST APIs.
  • Familiarity with architectural patterns like Hexagonal Architecture, Event Driven Architecture, A/B Testing, Feature Flags, and Gradual Rollouts.
  • Conversational Experience: Demonstrated experience in building chatbots, conversational interfaces, or integrating natural language processing (NLP) tools. Familiarity with chatbot frameworks (e.g., DialogFlow, IBM Watson, Rasa) is a plus.
  • Passion for building products that positively impact millions.
  • Commitment to continuous learning and exploration of new technologies.
  • Ability to thrive in a collaborative environment and contribute actively with innovative ideas.
  • Excellent prioritization skills.
  • Curiosity and/or experience in Fintech is an added advantage (though equivalent competencies will also be considered).

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary
  • Initial stock options grant
  • Annual performance bonus
  • Health, dental, and vision plans
  • Remote work environment, although we have offices in Miami and México City and would love to work in hybrid model if you are up to it.
  • Continuous learning opportunities
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Paid parental leave
  • Empowering opportunities for growth in a dynamic entrepreneurial environment

title: Director of Finance, Real Estate and Capital Asset Development
description:
Overview

Director of Finance, Real Estate and Capital Asset Development

Be among the first 25 applicants. Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Basic Function

The Director of Real Estate Finance plays a pivotal leadership role in the financial planning, investment strategy, and execution of complex real estate transactions within the Real Estate Development and Capital Asset Management (REDCAM) portfolio. Reporting to the Vice President and Chief Real Estate Officer, this role is responsible for guiding financial strategy for student housing, commercial development, acquisitions, ground leases, and joint ventures in support of the University’s strategic mission.

This position requires advanced financial acumen, a deep understanding of institutional real estate, and the ability to lead through highly complex development initiatives in alignment with the University’s strategic plan and the approved Campus Master Plan. The Director oversees financial analysis, long range capital planning, transaction structuring, and performance monitoring to ensure the portfolio supports institutional goals, adheres to risk parameters, and maintains financial sustainability. Additionally, the Director must create and support an environment that fosters teamwork, leadership development, integrity, and service responsiveness, while effectively managing relationships with business partners, regulatory agencies, and internal and external stakeholders.

Supervisory Accountability

The incumbent is responsible for overseeing the successful completion of projects, and is therefore expected to ensure all contributing parties remain on task, on time, and on budget. While this position does not have formal direct reports, the Director leads cross-functional deal teams composed of analysts, external advisors, consultants, and university stakeholders.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include executives, administrators, faculty, students, and staff of the university at large.

External contacts include housing partners, investors and lenders, consultants, contractors, local regulatory agencies, historical societies, local surrounding communities, representatives from other colleges and universities, visitors, and the general public.

Principal Accountabilities

Financial Analysis and Reporting

  • Conduct comprehensive financial analyses and prepare reports to assess key performance indicators and operational efficiencies.

Strategic Financial Planning

  • Long-term financial planning for the University’s real estate portfolio that anticipates and responds to legislative changes affecting higher education specifically. Develop scenario based financial models and sensitivity analysis in coordination with the Office of Data Analytics and External Affairs that incorporate potential regulatory changes, mitigate risk, and capitalize on new opportunities.

Budgeting And Forecasting

  • Support the budgeting process, implementing financial models for accurate forecasting.

Investment And Strategic Planning And Analysis

  • Support pre-transaction analysis and due diligence, including financial modeling and pro forma analysis, cost-benefit or return on investment analysis, feasibility analysis, market research, and review of third party reports such as market demand studies, environmental assessments, appraisals, facility assessment reports, among others.
  • Evaluate new investment opportunities and support the development of strategies for long-term needs and uses of the University’s real property assets including acquisitions, development, leasing, and disposition of assets.
  • Review all real estate agreements, documents, and contracts working with the Office of General Counsel to ensure compliance with the university strategic plans and procedures, and compliance with pertinent District of Columbia and Maryland laws, as applicable.

Project Support

  • Provide financial guidance to enhance property management financial efficiency and cost control. Provides support for a portfolio of real estate projects, entailing development, construction, property management, legal, and financial components.

Stakeholder Communication

  • Prepare and clearly communicate transaction analysis, financial data and strategies to university stakeholders, regarding structure, economics, mission benefits, progress, etc.

Academic Collaboration

  • Works collaboratively with the offices of the Chief Financial Officer and other members of the Administrative Services Leadership Team.

Presentation Support

  • Support the preparation of RFQ/RFP responses for all bids, ensuring compliance to policy and procedure, including zoning laws and securing public approval.
  • Preparation of materials and presentations for the Facilities and Real Estate Committee and the Board of Trustees.

Administrative Support

  • Provide administrative support as needed, including contract review and revision in coordination with outside counsel, and tracking and managing project budgets. Oversee these functions through to completion, ensuring compliance with all University processes and procedures.

Perform other related duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

Analytical and Strategic Thinking

  • Ability to perform complex financial underwriting, and conduct complex structuring including joint ventures, development, and debt instruments.
  • Knowledge of underwriting and closing debt and equity transactions locally, regionally, and nationally.
  • Must possess advanced analytical skills in evaluating real estate transactions.
  • Ability to gather and thoroughly analyze information in order to make well-founded recommendations to the University’s Senior Administration.

Communication, Organizational, And Interpersonal Skills

  • Demonstrate the ability to use sound judgment and to be an effective decision maker.
  • Ability to convey complex financial information clearly and build strong relationships with university and external stakeholders.
  • Strong attention to detail, and the ability to independently manage a transaction pipeline.
  • Excellent interpersonal, written, verbal, and analytical skills.
  • Ability to establish and maintain harmonious work relationships with students, staff, faculty, University officials, and the general public.
  • Ability to develop knowledge of, respect for, and skills to engage with those of other cultures or backgrounds is required.

Innovation And Problem-Solving

  • Creative approach to improving financial performance and operational processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to multi-task; to be a team player; and to be flexible and adaptable to change.

Technology Proficiency

  • Proven strength in the use of spreadsheets, database, and presentation applications, including Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint. Demonstrated proficiency in financial modeling and analysis tools.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Real Estate, Economics, or related field
  • MBA with a concentration in Finance, Real Estate, or related field
  • Minimum 12-15 years of related work experience, including real estate focused banking, development, finance, underwriting, structured finance, fundamental credit analysis, consulting, urban planning, and/or public policy; including experience with institutional or public-sector projects.
  • CFA or CAIA candidate status is strongly preferred.
  • 15 years of related work experience may be substituted in lieu of educational qualifications.
  • Strong analytical, financial modeling, and reporting skills.
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and project management abilities.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and financial software.

title: Senior Information Security Engineer (GRC)
description:
Senior Information Security Engineer (GRC)

About The Role: As an Information Security Engineer focused on Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) at Clutch, you will own and mature our trust foundation. You will operationalize our security controls, drive evidence collection and continuous monitoring, and partner with product, engineering, and business teams to reduce risk while enabling speed.

About The Team: You will join a small, high‑impact Security team that partners closely with Infrastructure, Product Engineering, Legal, and GTM. We value outcome‑oriented builders, clear documentation, and automation over manual audits. We work in the open, do frequent retros, and iterate quickly to support a rapidly scaling fintech SaaS platform serving credit unions and their members.

What You’ll Do

Within 3 months, you will:

  • Baseline our control library mapped to SOC 2, PCI DSS, and key fintech obligations. Stand up gaps and remediation owners in our ticketing system.
  • Implement lightweight evidence collection pipelines for top controls such as access reviews, backup tests, vulnerability management, and CI/CD change management.
  • Complete a security risk register refresh with likelihood and impact ratings, and publish a quarterly risk report.

Within 6 months, you will:

  • Lead our next SOC 2 Type II audit cycle end‑to‑end, including auditor coordination, population requests, and walkthroughs.
  • Roll out a vendor risk management workflow integrated with procurement and Legal, including tiering, due diligence, and continuous monitoring.
  • Partner with Engineering to define secure SDLC checkpoints and automate evidence from GitHub, CI, and cloud.

Within 9 months, you will:

  • Drive PCI DSS certification readiness, including SoA ownership, internal audits, and management review inputs.
  • Establish KPI/KRIs and dashboards for control effectiveness and risk trends consumed by execs and customers.
  • Mature incident response playbooks and conduct at least one cross‑functional tabletop with measurable improvements.

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years in GRC, security engineering, or risk management within SaaS or fintech environments.
  • Proven experience running SOC 2 Type II and working toward ISO 27001, including evidence automation and auditor interactions.
  • Strong understanding of cloud security controls across AWS, containerized workloads, and modern CI/CD.
  • Practical knowledge of secure SDLC, vulnerability management, identity and access management, and third‑party risk.
  • Ability to translate requirements into actionable, ticketed work with clear owners and due dates.
  • Excellent written communication for policies, customer questionnaires, and exec‑level reporting.
  • Nice to have: experience with privacy programs, PCI readiness, or financial services regulations; relevant certs (e.g., CISA, CISSP, ISO 27001 LI/LA) are a plus.

Please note that this role may evolve as our business needs change, so we appreciate your flexibility and adaptability.

What’s In It For You?

  • Remote Flexibility: Enjoy the freedom of remote work from anywhere, balancing life and career seamlessly.
  • Unforgettable Off-Sites: Twice a year, bond with colleagues in exciting destinations, fostering teamwork and fresh ideas.
  • Paid Time Off and National Holidays: Enjoy 20 PTO days yearly and the National Holidays for relaxation and rejuvenation.
  • Stock Options: You’ll receive stock options as part of your compensation package.
  • Home Office Setup: Create your ideal workspace with a dedicated budget for home office essentials.
  • Work Trip Budget: Grow personally and professionally with a budget for work-related trips and co-working.

About Us

Clutch is a revolutionary vertical SaaS company, backed by Andreessen Horowitz (A16z), aimed at revolutionizing the way Credit Unions engage and change the lives of their members. We address the urgent need for affordable lending solutions in an era where many households carry debt. Our software helps Credit Unions become FinTech lenders to responsibly lend to millions of Americans. Our mission is to enhance how credit unions interact with their members through cutting‑edge technologies and user‑centric designs. This approach preserves the community and member‑focused service at the heart of credit unions.

Please note: This position is offered on a contractor basis. Applicants must have the necessary documentation and authorization to work in the country where the job is located. We cannot provide sponsorship or help with obtaining work permits for this role.

A Note About AI At Clutch
We love AI. We use it often and encourage our team to creatively and effectively leverage AI tools. If you join Clutch, we hope you’ll bring the same enthusiasm for exploring how AI can amplify impact, productivity, and innovation. During the interview process, we want to hear your thoughts. Please approach interviews without the use of AI tools—our goal is to understand how you think, solve problems, and communicate. Once you’re in the seat, bring on the prompts!

Job title: Senior Software Engineer I, Manage Company

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow.

As we continue expanding beyond Venture Capital into Private Equity markets, we’re building solutions to address the unique challenges of clients managing companies and funds structured as LLCs. These entities vary widely in contractual structures and represent diverse asset classes, requiring a flexible and scalable data model that supports distinct product experiences. Additionally, Private Equity firms, their investors, legal partners, and portfolio companies interact with our platform through different user personas and permissions, making robust access control and tailored experiences essential.

title: Senior Well Site Leader
description:
Overview

Senior Well Site Leader (WSL) at bp. The WSL is accountable for leading all activities, HSSE, operations, and logistics at the well site for well construction activities (drilling and completion), workover and intervention activities, with the goal of meeting or exceeding performance metrics. The WSL is the BP site representative for Wells and will lead Wells and Contractor Personnel to ensure that well operations under their control are carried out in a manner that adheres to BP’s Who We Are framework, conforms to BP’s OMS, practices and procedures, and aligns with local government regulations. The WSL is a safety critical role due to the impact of decisions on operations. While onshore, the WSL is embedded in the operations team and supports planning and execution activities for well construction, workover and intervention to meet or exceed performance metrics. The WSL ensures adherence to BP’s Who We Are framework, conforms to the requirements of BP’s OMS, practices and procedures, and stays in sync with local government regulations. The WSL supports the development of junior staff and ensures lessons and experience are transferred across rig lines.

Experience

Significant well operations experience, with sufficient experience working at the well site in a supervisory position. Experience working in and preferably supervising multi-disciplinary teams.

Qualifications

  • Excellent social skills with the ability to communicate at all levels to effectively manage multi-disciplinary scopes of work.
  • Successfully completed or undertake a WSL competency assessment.
  • Valid Well Control Certificate (WellSharp or IWCF).
  • BOSIET or HUET training for locations requiring helicopter transit to the Wellsite.
  • Education: Minimum of a High School Diploma or equivalent.
  • Desirable Education: Degree in engineering, science or technical field.

Key Accountabilities & Responsibilities

  • The WSL establishes the leadership culture—setting priorities and ensuring they are understood at site inductions, daily meetings and pre-job meetings.
  • BP’s lead representative on a well site, primarily leading a team of contract workers, assuring procedural subject area is followed.
  • Accountable for running daily operations planning, ensuring the plan is understood, communicated to onsite senior contractor representatives, cascaded to personnel performing the work, and fully understood.
  • Contributes to well planning and learning processes through input into drilling procedures, forward programmes and BP’s continuous improvement processes; participates in Well Program reviews with the Engineering team and ensures onsite lessons are gathered and shared effectively.
  • Management and control of operational costs; actively pursue cost saving and innovative solutions for well work operations.
  • Ensures site safety and environment management systems are implemented as designed and are consistent with BP’s policies and standards.
  • Responsible for data accuracy in morning reports (NPT and operational coding) to ensure accurate performance reporting.
  • Leads BP’s task-level self-verification and Contractor oversight checks at the Wellsite.
  • Stops the job and assesses risk for any program changes or changes to risk mitigation barriers; informs the Wellsite Update Point (WSUP) of changes to the risk profile.
  • Ensures Well Control procedures are understood and implemented by the Wellsite team.
  • Leads planning, coordination and prioritization of materials and logistics to and from the Wellsite.
  • Verifies awareness and conformance to Well Control and SMS Bridging documents with Wellsite teams.
  • Owns initiatives to maximize efficiency by measuring performance and implementing improvement opportunities.

Onshore Working Context

  • Commitment to well planning and learning processes; participates in Well Program reviews with the Engineering team and shares onsite lessons.
  • Demonstrates strong communication skills to identify opportunities for operational efficiency, emerging risks, and safety concerns.
  • Systematically shares takeaways and procedures across teams and rig lines.

Key Competencies

  • Core: Personal & Process Safety, Procedures and Practices, OMS, Risk Assessment and Management.
  • Subject area: Life of Well Design, Equipment Integrity Assurance, Well Integrity, Well Control, Well Performance, Slick Line, Electric Line, Coil Tubing, Tubular Handling, Cementing, Drill String Handling, Wellhead and Tree Installation, Directional Drilling and Surveying techniques.

Development & Training

  • Close out gaps identified in WSL competency assessment.
  • Provide support and coaching to ensure safe and efficient execution of activities.
  • Mentor and supervise the development of less experienced WSLs and engineering staff on the rigsite.

Leadership and Behavioural Traits

  • Proactively lives BP values, including Code of Conduct.
  • Informed Judgment: uses good practice and sound judgment to deliver safe, reliable Well Operations.
  • Commitment and Engagement: demonstrates personal commitment to delivering the plan and Continuous Improvement.
  • Systematic Management: progresses operational excellence through OMS.
  • Leadership Presence: demonstrates courage to safely manage risk.
  • Accountability: ensures safety compliance and performance expectations are clear and delivered.
  • Great Teammate: enables others to reach their potential.
  • Safety Leader: serves as a role model for others.

title: Chief Financial Officer
description:
Title: Chief Financial Officer

Location: Remote

About The Princeton Review

The Princeton Review (TPR) is a leading tutoring, test prep, and college admission services company. Every year, it helps millions of college- and graduate school–bound students achieve their education and career goals through online and in-person courses delivered by a network of more than 4,000 teachers and tutors, online resources, and its more than 150 print and digital books published by Penguin Random House. The company’s Tutor.com brand is one of the largest online tutoring services in the U.S. It comprises a community of thousands of tutors who have delivered more than 28 million one-to-one tutoring sessions. The Princeton Review is headquartered in New York, NY. Follow the company on LinkedIn, YouTube and Instagram.

About the Position

We’re seeking a strategic and results-driven Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to lead The Princeton Review and Tutor.com’s financial strategy, planning, and business operations. Reporting directly to the Chief Executive Officer, the CFO will be a key member of the executive leadership team, responsible for shaping the financial future of the organization and ensuring fiscal discipline across all business units.

The CFO will oversee all aspects of financial management, including budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, treasury, and compliance. This role will also oversee business operations including corporate real estate and supply chain. This role requires a visionary leader who can align financial strategy with organizational goals, drive operational efficiency, and support sustainable growth. The CFO will work closely with senior leaders across departments to provide data-driven insights, guide investment decisions, and ensure the company maintains a strong financial foundation to serve its diverse student populations.

This is a pivotal role with significant impact on the company’s performance, requiring a blend of strategic foresight, operational excellence, and collaborative leadership.

What You\'ll Do

As Chief Financial Officer, you will lead the financial strategy and operations of The Princeton Review and Tutor.com, ensuring the organization’s fiscal health and supporting its long-term growth. Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Strategic Financial Leadership: Develop and execute financial strategies that align with the company’s mission, growth objectives, and operational priorities.
  • Financial Planning & Analysis: Oversee budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning processes to ensure financial sustainability and performance.
  • Reporting & Compliance: Ensure accurate and timely financial reporting, compliance with regulatory requirements, and successful completion of audits.
  • Treasury & Capital Management: Manage cash flow, banking relationships, and capital allocation to optimize financial resources and support strategic investments.
  • Executive Collaboration: Partner with the CEO and executive team to provide financial insights and support data-driven decision-making across departments.
  • Operational Oversight: Lead business operations including corporate real estate and supply chain, driving efficiency and cost-effectiveness across the enterprise.
  • Team Leadership: Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing finance team, fostering a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  • Technology & Systems: Oversee financial systems and tools, driving automation and scalability to support a growing and dynamic organization.

Who You Are

  • A seasoned financial executive with 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in corporate finance, and ideally within multi-unit or service-based organizations.
  • The successful candidate will bring deep expertise in financial planning and analysis, accounting, treasury, and compliance, with a proven track record driving strategic growth and operational efficiency.
  • Successfully led finance teams through periods of transformation and are adept at aligning financial strategy with business objectives.
  • Possess strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and engage stakeholders at all levels, including board members and investors.
  • Data-driven decision-maker, skilled in leveraging financial analytics to guide investment decisions, manage risk and optimize performance.
  • Experienced in managing complex budgets, forecasting models, and financial systems, and have overseen audits, regulatory reporting, and capital planning.
  • Collaborative and inclusive leader who builds high-performing teams and fosters a culture of accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement.
  • Comfortable operating in dynamic environments and bringing a strategic mindset with hands-on operational capabilities.

What We Offer

The Princeton Review is an equal employment opportunity employer. The Princeton Review’s policy is not to discriminate against any applicant or employee based on, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, disability, military status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. The Princeton Review also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories. title: Senior Director, Counsel, Legal TLM - Catalyze360 (Transactions)
description:
Overview

At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. We are a global healthcare leader headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. Our employees work to discover and bring life-changing medicines to those who need them, improve the understanding and management of disease, and give back to our communities through philanthropy and volunteerism. We’re looking for people who are determined to make life better for people around the world. Lilly Catalyze360, a Division of Lilly Research Laboratories, is a comprehensive approach to enabling the early-stage biotech ecosystem, agnostic of the therapeutic area. There are four pillars: Lilly Gateway Labs, ExploR&D, Lilly Ventures and Lilly TuneLab. Learn more about Catalyze360 at:

Lilly Gateway Labs links Lilly to an entrepreneurial community fostering innovation. It provides biotech companies direct access to Lilly scientists and expertise, opportunities to collaborate on projects of mutual interest, and learning forums with Lilly experts and partners, with potential for financial investment from Lilly or venture funds. Learn more at:

ExploR&D is a drug development organization within Catalyze360 focused on catalyzing the biotechnology ecosystem. It advances investigational medicines for external sponsors with speed and efficiency and supports programs across North America, Europe, and Asia. Learn more at:

Lilly Ventures maintains relationships with life science-focused funds to gain access to emerging science, with three portfolios (Therapeutics, Technology, and Impact) and investment tools including fund partnerships and direct investments.

Lilly TuneLab provides access to AI/ML tools leveraging Lilly's drug discovery models.

Position

The successful candidate for the Senior Director, Counsel, Legal TLM - Catalyze360 (Transactions) will be a core member of Lilly’s legal team, helping drive the company’s mission and serving as a trusted advisor and leader to the Catalyze360 team. The role offers the opportunity to contribute immediately to Lilly’s growth and success. We seek a proven leader who is motivated, proactive, thrives in ambiguity, self-starting, and enjoys challenges.

Primary Responsibilities

This position provides legal support for the Lilly Gateway Labs and ExploR&D capabilities of Catalyze360 and will have the following responsibilities:

  • Lead the structuring, drafting, negotiating and counseling on transactions (including licenses and collaborations, R&D services, equity investments, divestitures and other transactions).
  • Serve as both a legal and business partner in structuring and implementing new Catalyze360 offerings and transaction models.
  • Develop agreement templates and playbooks and lead training for the Catalyze360 team.
  • Identify and resolve critical legal and business issues throughout the lifecycle of Catalyze360 agreements, including post-transaction alliance management support.
  • Partner with the Catalyze360 team and other internal stakeholders to ensure strategic alignment and support the growth of the Catalyze360 organization.
  • Exercise excellent judgment to influence and drive decision-making.
  • Cultivate and contribute to the development of a high-performance transactions legal team and a collaborative culture with colleagues in the legal department and other key functions.
  • Demonstrate a service-oriented approach to advising internal client groups.
  • Serve as a recognized source of innovative ideas in complex areas of law, business, or technology with respect to transactional matters.

Basic Requirements

  • J.D. from an ABA-accredited law school.
  • Admitted to the bar in at least one state.
  • Minimum of six (6) years of legal experience drafting, reviewing and negotiating sophisticated transactions in either a law firm or in-house, or a combination of both.
  • Significant experience drafting and negotiating complex transaction agreements in the pharmaceutical or life sciences industry (including CRO and CDMO agreements).
  • Authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Lilly will not sponsor work authorization or visas for this role.

Additional Skills/Preferences

  • Ability to proactively identify opportunities for creative and innovative solutions to transactional issues and process improvements.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills and business judgment with the ability to influence others.
  • Strong interpersonal skills to manage internal client expectations and collaborate in cross-functional teams within a matrix environment.
  • Professional demeanor with the gravitas to lead and influence a seasoned business team.
  • Fast, nimble, and able to pivot between audiences to provide timely legal and business advice.
  • Team-oriented, collaborative, and capable of working independently.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple projects with priorities and deadlines.
  • Analytical and strategic with the ability to devise creative solutions to drive toward recommendations and closure.
  • Impeccable integrity and ability to handle confidential matters with discretion.
  • Ability to lead outside counsel selection and oversee legal costs.

Learn more about all groups.

description:
SUPERVISOR OPERAÇÕES LEVES ( AEROPORTO SANTOS DUMONT/RJ)

Unidas Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Resumo da vaga
Unidas, integrante do grupo Brookfield, é uma das maiores empresas do setor de mobilidade no Brasil. Conta com cerca de 100 mil ativos entre veículos leves, caminhões, máquinas e equipamentos pesados, e oferece uma plataforma completa de soluções de gestão e locação de veículos, operações e manutenção, trazendo economia e praticidade para pessoas e empresas em todo o país. A companhia tem mais de 4 mil colaboradores e é reconhecida como uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil pelo Great Place to Work. Também já foi eleita a 32ª marca mais valiosa pelo Brand Finance Brazil e, por sete vezes, conquistou o Prêmio Consumidor Moderno de Excelência em Serviço ao Cliente na categoria “Locadora de veículos”.

Empoderamos as pessoas do nosso time e investimos no aprendizado diário e desenvolvimento contínuo. Aqui, cada Unilover é responsável por sua carreira e a leva para onde quiser.

Responsabilidades

  • Apoiar o time de analistas de operações, garantindo a máxima disponibilidade dos carros para as lojas da Rede RAC obedecendo a um rigoroso padrão de qualidade (conservação, manutenção, limpeza e abastecimento) e de acordo com a demanda diária/futura.
  • Garantir o engajamento da equipe para disponibilizar veículos com qualidade dentro do padrão Unidas.
  • Garantir escala e gestão da equipe para atendimento aos clientes, organização e funcionamento correto das lojas.
  • Garantir que as cobranças de reembolsáveis sejam realizadas dentro da meta pré-definida.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino superior completo.
  • Desejáveis conhecimentos de gestão em transportadoras, concessionárias, frotas e/ou locadoras.

  • Convênio Médico;
  • Convênio Odontológico;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Vale Refeição e/ou Alimentação;
  • Cartão Farmácia;
  • WellHub;
  • Clube de Vantagens;
  • Carro da empresa;
  • Cartão flex;
  • Programa de Lucros e Resultados.

Sobre a Unidas

Na Unidas, carreira é jornada, não destino. Somos um dos maiores grupos do Brasil no setor de mobilidade e terceirização de frotas, com soluções que vão de veículos leves a pesados, passando por máquinas e equipamentos. Valorizamos o desenvolvimento contínuo, o aprendizado diário e o empoderamento individual. Acreditamos que cada talento pode transformar realidades e oferecemos as ferramentas, o ambiente e os desafios certos para isso acontecer. Somos parte de algo maior: integrados ao portfólio Brookfield Asset Management, uma das maiores gestoras de ativos do mundo, com visão de longo prazo e compromisso com o desenvolvimento sustentável.

Seja bem-vindo(a)! A Unidas é o seu caminho para crescer, aprender, inovar e fazer parte de uma história de transformação. Aqui sua carreira tem direção, propósito e movimento.

title: Supervisor (a) de Produção - Programa de Desenvolvimento Acelerado
description:
Supervisor (a) de Produção - Programa de Desenvolvimento Acelerado

Key Expected Achievements

  1. Member of the Operations team: the Business Unit Leader aspires to drive the performance of the Shop first, even before their own Business Unit. For this, they are actively involved in:
    • a. Sharing best practices between Business Units and helping to contribute to the Plant performance in a collaborative manner. We maintain a mindset of “ONE MANUFACTURING TEAM” in all situations.
    • b. Detecting & developing talents that will grow their career in the Shop. They develop and export talent from their Business Unit to other activities to support business needs.
    • c. Supporting Shop decisions even when uncertainty and unfavorable circumstances may impact their own Business Unit.
    • d. Improve the performance of the Business Unit through regular coaching and feedback of support team members.
    • e. Provide input on the performance of support team members as well as recommendations for development.
  2. People developer: the Business Unit Leader is animated with the passion for people development, seeing their plant as a platform to recruit, train & offer professional growth for everyone in their teams. The Business Unit Leader is expected to:
    • a. Deploy a life-long learning mindset in the teams, through evaluation of competencies and identifying development opportunities to close the gaps.
    • b. Ensure the development of people through the avenue of Spoke training by support teams or through social promotion projects.
    • c. Utilize career paths accessible for all their employees.
    • d. Build and believe in the value of diverse teams.
    • e. Support competency development through mentoring & coaching.
  3. Representative/Role model of the Company values, purpose & strategy: the Business Unit Leader represents the Plant for the employees. They embody the group values by:
    • a. Consistently living out the values and acting as an example to inspire their employees by their behaviors.
    • b. Motivating their teams by leveraging the Michelin purpose & Dream.
    • c. Making sure that everyone in their Team understands the Plant strategy and understands the role that they play in the collective success of the vision.
    • d. Aligning the vision at the shop level and engaging the teams to make that vision a reality at the site.
    • e. Embodying the values of the Company by ensuring employee issues are addressed in a timely fashion. Ensure accurate, on-time completion of time and attendance for employees and address attendance issues in a timely fashion.
    • f. Developing Safety as a value in the Business Unit, such that each employee is responsible for their safety and the safety of others.
  4. Customer & business partner: the Business Unit Leader understands the customers’ needs and the business stakes and guide the teams to be customer centric. The Business Unit Leader is expected to:
    • a. Develop an understanding of the Customer/partners and their requirements and the role their Business Unit has in meeting their expectations.
    • b. Steer their Business Unit, focused on all dimensions of economic value creation.
    • c. Support the business through a cooperation with local teams for: industrializations, modifications, digitalization, Industry transformations, etc.
  5. Environment promoter: the Business Unit Leader is viewed as an active promoter and influencer for continuous improvement in the environmental impact of their Business Unit by:
    • a. Promoting a culture that is aware and values sustainability and environment.
    • b. Complying/Implementing the strategy for environmental impact and biodiversity.

Care Area of Excellence

  1. ICARe & Empowerment role model: the Business Unit Leader is visibly striving to lead with the ICARE leadership model and inspires and coaches their team to progress in that direction. The Business Unit Leader is expected to:
    • a. Inspire and transfer their passion for ICARE to all employees at all levels, through the animation of a continuous deployment of the model in their Business Unit.
    • b. Create the condition for inclusion, safe-space, collaboration & collective intelligence in their team.
    • c. Foster empowerment through the engagement of their shop Support Teams, so that everyone can feel responsible for the plant’s future and fully take part in the evolution and transformation.
  2. Operational Excellence Leader: the Business Unit Leader is committed to develop the operational excellence by ensuring that:
    • a. Activities are driven by applying MMW(MDP+OR/MAPP), because the teams understand the value of such practices of excellence. Foundations are sustained over time, in order to create the conditions to achieve industrial performance.
    • b. The driving of continuous progress in the Business Unit, looking for variation reduction and non-added value tasks reduction, is vigorous.
    • c. Achieve Business Unit SMQDC expected performance levels and respect of standards to satisfy customer demand.
    • d. The team and its members are empowered and visibly committed. Autonomy increases through the evolution of polyvalence, competencies and responsibility.
    • e. Uses sound problem solving methodology to eliminate root causes of problems as they arise.

Tech Area of Excellence

  1. Digital and Innovation contributor: Adopt innovation, engineering, and technology ensuring the transformation is recognized as an opportunity for excellence by:
    • a. Seeking opportunity to apply and encourage team to work with and use digital application where appropriate. Apply “use cases” to help team move forward to data driven approach.
    • b. Helping to build the foundations necessary for the transformation (data quality, competencies, organization, plant roadmap, collaboration with Site Digital Department).
    • c. Supporting and triggering projects and initiatives that will develop capabilities aligned with the Michelin strategy. Highlight the importance to copy/paste digital good practices.

title: Senior Solutions & Product Architect (Deputy CTO)
description:
Join Our Team

Oowlish, one of Latin America's rapidly expanding software development companies, is seeking experienced technology professionals to enhance our diverse and vibrant team.

As a valued member of Oowlish, you will collaborate with premier clients from the United States and Europe, contributing to pioneering digital solutions. Our commitment to creating a nurturing work environment is recognized by our certification as a Great Place to Work, where you will have opportunities for professional development, growth, and a chance to make a significant international impact.

We offer the convenience of remote work, allowing you to craft a work-life balance that suits your personal and professional needs. We're looking for candidates who are passionate about technology, proficient in English, and excited to engage in remote collaboration for a worldwide presence.

We’re looking for a Senior Solutions & Product Architect (Deputy CTO) to join our leadership team and scale alongside our cofounder & CTO. This is a client-facing, high-impact role that blends product strategy, solution architecture, and delivery leadership .

What You’ll Do:

  • Partner with clients from day one to understand their business needs and shape solutions.
  • Define high-level product requirements, MVP scopes, and roadmaps.
  • Translate business goals into technical architectures and delivery plans.
  • Lead proposal creation (business framing + product requirements + technical approach).
  • Oversee delivery across multiple teams, ensuring quality and accountability.
  • Be a trusted advisor to clients, while mentoring engineering teams internally.
  • Help codify Oowlish’s playbooks so we can scale beyond any single leader.

Must Have:

  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering, solution architecture, or product/technical consulting.
  • Strong technical breadth (cloud, APIs, modern architectures).
  • Proven ability to lead multiple teams/projects and communicate with C-level stakeholders.
  • Experience defining product requirements and MVPs , not just technical designs.
  • Excellent communication skills (English required; Spanish/Portuguese a plus ).
  • Backgrounds that could be a great fit:
  • Experience in consulting / outsourcing firms.
  • CTOs or co-founders of startups, with hands-on experience balancing product, tech, and business.
  • Entrepreneurial, proactive, and excited to grow into a future CTO/Partner role.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Home office

  • Career plans to allow for extensive growth in the company

description:
Inclusão e respeito à diversidade e equidade fazem parte do DNA da KPMG.

Aqui valorizamos todas as pessoas, encorajando e empoderando os nossos profissionais para que se sintam parte das nossas conquistas.

Independente da sua idade, gênero, raça, cor, credo, orientação, sexual, etnia, origem nacional ou deficiência, te convidamos a fazer a diferença. Venha fazer parte do time KPMG!

  • Fazemos o que é certo #Integrity
  • Aprendemos e nos aprimoramos #Excellence
  • Pensamos e agimos de maneira arrojada #Courage
  • Respeitamos uns aos outros e nos fortalecemos com nossas diferenças #Together
  • Fazemos o que realmente importa #For Better

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Caso seja aprovado(a), você terá a oportunidade de:

  • Instruir o cliente em relação aos impactos das mudanças nas regras de preços de transferência, alinhadas com as diretrizes da OCDE;
  • Avaliar o impacto financeiro das mudanças nas regras de preços de transferência, alinhado com as diretrizes da OCDE para as operações do cliente;
  • Aplicação das novas regras de preços de transferência às transações intercompany referentes ao negócio;
  • Análise funcional para identificação do perfil da entidade, bem como para delinear as transações intercompany e os respectivos métodos de transfer pricing;
  • Simulação de impactos financeiros, indicativa dos preços de transferência, tendo como base a Demonstração de Resultados do Exercício (DRE);
  • Análise econômica e de comparabilidade para fins de determinar o preço a ser praticado, considerando o indicador financeiro, o método mais apropriado e o intervalo interquartil mais apropriado;
  • Preparo de documentação de preços de transferência, incluindo arquivo local, arquivo global e ECF, bem como documentação de suporte;
  • Auxílio na preparação de acordos de preços de transferência e interfaces com regras de tributação internacional;
  • Análise dos rendimentos e das transações controladas para fins de tributação no Brasil (imposto de renda, PIS, COFINS etc.).

Requisitos e qualificações

O que procuramos em você?

  • Formação em: Direito, Economia, Contabilidade, Finanças e áreas correlatas.
  • Conhecimento em: Tributação Internacional, incluindo o entendimento dos princípios contábeis internacionais.
  • Experiência em: preços de transferência de acordo com as diretrizes da OCDE, incluindo a aplicação de métodos de preços de transferência, cálculos de benchmarking, análise de indicadores econômicos e conhecimento de modelos de negócios e setores diversificados, preparo e revisão de documentação de preços de transferência e análise de riscos fiscais.
  • Conhecimento de tributação internacional e de tributação da renda, especialmente em aplicação de tratados internacionais, diretrizes da OCDE, projeto BEPS, legislação fiscal doméstica e direito comparado.
  • Experiência em análise de dados e modelagem financeira, incluindo a utilização de ferramentas de análise de dados para identificar tendências e padrões.
  • Habilidade em comunicação e apresentação, incluindo a capacidade de explicar conceitos complexos de preços de transferência de forma clara e persuasiva.
  • Habilidade em gestão de projetos, incluindo a capacidade de gerenciar múltiplos projetos simultaneamente e cumprir prazos.
  • Conhecimento em negociação, incluindo a capacidade de negociar acordos de preços antecipados (APA) e resolver disputas fiscais.
  • Habilidade em liderança, incluindo a capacidade de liderar equipes e fornecer orientação e treinamento para outros profissionais de transfer pricing.
  • Necessário inglês fluente.
  • Residir no Rio de Janeiro ou Belo Horizonte.

Overview

EY Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. Oportunidade de atuação híbrida no escritório de São Paulo/Rio de Janeiro/Porto Alegre, atuando na área de Tax (FSO) com foco na indústria financeira, em consultoria tributária, projetos de compliance e impostos diretos (CSLL e IRPJ) para bancos e seguradoras.

Em FSO, apoiamos organizações a prosperar em uma era de mudanças rápidas, oferecendo serviços em disciplinas tributárias e combinando conhecimento, pessoas e tecnologia para atender às necessidades relacionadas a impostos sobre transações, impostos internacionais e questões fiscais ligadas a pessoas, conformidade e relatórios.

Por que você?

Como Gerente de Tributos, você fará parte da área de Tax com atuação na indústria financeira, com responsabilidades de consultoria tributária, gestão de projetos de compliance e impostos diretos, liderando equipes e contribuindo para a melhoria contínua dos serviços de EY.

Responsabilidades

  • Liderar equipes de auditoria na revisão de cálculos, identificação de riscos e exposições;
  • Realizar a revisão e preparação de imposto diferido e projeções conforme ASC 740 e IAS 12, bem como Tax Provision e reconciliação da alíquota efetiva;
  • Rever e preparar a apuração do imposto de renda e contribuição social, seguindo normas aplicáveis;
  • Realizar pesquisas e responder consultas tributárias de clientes;
  • Atuar na revisão e preparação da ECF (Escrituração Contábil Fiscal) e ECD (Escrituração Contábil Digital);
  • Desenvolver e manter relacionamentos produtivos com funcionários de clientes e avaliar satisfação;
  • Supervisionar o trabalho de campo diário, informar aos supervisores sobre a situação do trabalho e gerenciar o desempenho da equipe;

Ready to revolutionize education through AI? We are seeking a visionary product strategist to spearhead our Education vertical and champion a mission that matters: helping students learn more effectively through personalized instruction. As our Head of Product Growth, you\'ll craft the strategic blueprint that unifies our educational offerings into a cohesive ecosystem. You\'ll author our definitive "Brain Lift" strategy document and translate it into actionable roadmaps that make our products work in harmony. This player-coach role requires you to dive deep into critical work while guiding a talented team of Product Owners toward measurable impact.

We\'re challenging the status quo of one-size-fits-all education by building a system rooted in learning science and AI that adapts to each student\'s unique needs. Our mission is proving that education can be simultaneously personalized and powerful.

This position diverges from conventional product leadership roles. Success here isn\'t measured by process management or delegation skills, but by your ability to drive tangible outcomes through first-principles thinking, analytical rigor, and unwavering determination.

Working directly with founders and leading a sharp team, your ultimate metric is straightforward: demonstrable evidence that your strategy has meaningfully enhanced student learning outcomes. If you\'re energized by accountability and eager to tackle education\'s most significant challenges, we should connect.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Craft and Evolve the Strategic Framework: Develop and continuously refine the comprehensive "Education Domain BrainLift"—a living strategic document that synthesizes team insights, market intelligence, and learning science into a unified vision guiding the entire vertical.
  • Orchestrate Portfolio Development: Transform strategic vision into an outcome-focused roadmap that coordinates all products within our ecosystem. You\'ll determine the strategic sequencing that maximizes compounding value and provides the "why" behind every initiative.
  • Lead Through Action and Mentorship: Serve as both strategist and practitioner—running your own rapid OODA (Observe-Orient-Decide-Act) loops on mission-critical objectives while elevating your team through thoughtful review and strategic guidance to ensure cohesive execution across the portfolio.

What You Won’t Be Doing

  • Functioning solely as a people manager. While leadership is essential, your value comes from strategic direction and execution standards, not administrative oversight of headcount and budgets.
  • Implementing predetermined strategies. You won\'t be executing someone else\'s vision—you\'ll be crafting the comprehensive strategy yourself, building it from first principles and ground-level insights.
  • Maintaining rigid, unchanging roadmaps. Your portfolio strategy will evolve continuously, incorporating weekly learnings and adapting to new discoveries from your team\'s work and your own investigations.
  • Managing disconnected feature development. Success isn\'t measured by feature quantity but by strategic outcomes that create synergy across products, breaking down silos to deliver unified educational experiences.

Basic Requirements

  • 6+ years in product leadership positions where you personally developed product vision and owned fundamental problem-solution hypotheses
  • Proven track record launching at least one successful product from conception to market—specifically a complete product (not just features) that reached external users and generated minimum $1M in revenue
  • Demonstrated proficiency integrating AI tools into your professional workflow (analysis, research, strategy development, information synthesis)

About LearnWith.AI

LearnWith.AI is an edtech startup that leverages AI and subject matter experts to cultivate a new way of learning. Our unique approach leverages 50+ years of learning science, cutting-edge data analytics and AI-powered coaching. In doing so, we can help students learn more, learn faster, and learn better - and have fun while doing it. We are a remote-first company that hires globally via Crossover.

Working with us

This is a full-time (40 hours per week), long-term position. description:
IRB(Re) Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Somos o maior ressegurador do Brasil. Com mais de 80 anos de experiência, atuamos nas principais linhas de negócios em resseguros e contamos com uma equipe altamente qualificada, pronta para inovar e oferecer os melhores produtos e serviços ao mercado.

Conheça os detalhes da vaga abaixo:

FORMAÇÃO ACADÊMICA:

  • Imprescindível graduação completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Desejável pós-graduação em Gestão de TI, Cloud Computing ou Segurança da Informação.
  • Será considerado diferencial: certificações relevantes (ITIL, AWS/Azure/GCP, Cisco, VMware, DevOps, FinOps, DevSecOps).
  • Experiência comprovada em gestão de infraestrutura corporativa complexa (on-premises e cloud).
  • Domínio em cloud híbrida (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS), redes corporativas, bancos de dados e telecom.
  • Conhecimento prático em DevOps, FinOps, automação e observabilidade.
  • Familiaridade com frameworks de governança e continuidade (ITIL, COBIT, ISO 27001, BCP/DRP).

MISSÃO DA POSIÇÃO:

Responsável por planejar, organizar e gerenciar a equipe e as operações da infraestrutura tecnológica do IRB(Re), garantindo a operação estável, segura e custo-eficiente de toda a camada de infraestrutura. Isso inclui data centers, redes, servidores, storage, ambientes de cloud híbrida, bancos de dados corporativos, telecomunicações, NOC, Service Desk e plataformas de automação/DevOps. Além disso, lidera a transformação digital por meio da adoção estruturada de cloud-first, automação, DevOps, DevSecOps e FinOps.

Estratégia e planejamento:

  • Definir e executar a estratégia de modernização da infraestrutura (cloud-first, automação, DevOps/FinOps/DevSecOps).
  • Planejar capacidade, disponibilidade e continuidade para sustentar o crescimento do negócio.
  • Assegurar que custos de cloud e infraestrutura estejam controlados e alinhados ao orçamento (FinOps).
  • Estabelecer SLAs claros para disponibilidade, performance e suporte.
  • Apoiar a definição de roadmaps tecnológicos junto à Arquitetura e Governança.

Gestão de Entrega:

  • Negociar com vendors, outsourcers e parceiros para aquisição de produtos e serviços de infraestrutura.
  • Avaliar, selecionar e implantar tecnologias que aumentem a resiliência, escalabilidade e automação da infraestrutura.
  • Apoiar a implantação de medidas de segurança em conjunto com o CISO (hardening, patching, criptografia, logs).

Gestão Operacional:

  • Gerir e priorizar a operação de redes, servidores, storage, cloud híbrida, bancos de dados e telecom.
  • Supervisionar NOC, Service Desk (N1/N2), Field Services e Engenharia de Plataforma.
  • Monitorar ambientes críticos com foco em disponibilidade, resiliência e performance.
  • Administrar ciclo de vida de hardware e software, incluindo patch management.
  • Conduzir práticas de observabilidade e automação (IaC, CI/CD).
  • Produzir relatórios executivos de custos, disponibilidade e performance.
  • Garantir documentação atualizada de topologias, processos e catálogos de serviços.

Qualifications

  • Arquitetura de dados: Sólido entendimento de arquiteturas de dados escaláveis, tanto para processamento em batch quanto em tempo real.
